races.race_name: BetVictor Steventon Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Persica
runners.spotlight: Went close when bidding for a second win in the Group 3 Diomed at Epsom (8.5f) in June, back to his best; respectable efforts over 1m2f since at Royal Ascot (good to firm; just over 3l ahead of Arabian Light) and Sandown (good) suggest he won't be far away.
runners.comment: Recent respectable 1m2f efforts at Royal Ascot and Sandown suggest he won't be far away

runners.name: Al Zanati
runners.spotlight: Won debut last August and a 1m1f AW Group 3 at Chantilly in November; runner-up in British Group 3s in two other starts, one on good to firm last October and the other in Classic Trial at Sandown (1m2f) this April; that's not the best form in this field and he wasn't so good in the Dante at York in May on latest outing, but this lightly raced 3yo could still bring potential and William Buick seemingly prefers him to Arabian Light.
runners.comment: Below form in Dante at York in May but this lightly raced 3yo could still bring potential

runners.name: Arabian Light
runners.spotlight: Success at Meydan early this year was followed by a creditable return to Britain, then a lesser show at Royal Ascot; the same happened in 2025, preceding another below-form effort in July, so that has to be a worry even though best efforts would see him on the premises; William Buick seemingly prefers Al Zanati.
runners.comment: Best efforts would see him on the premises; William Buick seemingly prefers Al Zanati

runners.name: Oceans Four
runners.spotlight: Group 2 Great Voltigeur entry; French Group 3 winner (1m, soft) last September; well behind Al Zanati in the Classic Trial at Sandown (1m2f, good) on reappearance but resumed improvement with a big run at 80-1 in Group 3 at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) one month ago, keeping on admirably for a close fourth of ten; better still may be needed in today's first-time headgear but he's in calculations.
runners.comment: 80-1 in Group 3 at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) but kept on admirably for a close 4th

runners.name: Silawi
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; last four races have been Grade or Group 1 in North America and Middle East; two of those runs take high rank among the form in this field and he also won twice over Windsor's 1m2f (handicap and Group 3) last summer, so he needs a close look despite the absence since February.
runners.comment: Not the most consistent but several runs take high rank among the form in this field

runners.name: Midak
runners.spotlight: Won his first three races in France last year (twice from the front) and just 9-1 when brought over for the Derby but faded badly into tenth; just useful form since, best of three runs for new yard when 3l fourth of six in a Listed race at Goodwood (1m4f, soft) last time but he needs markedly better than that.
runners.comment: Has not lived up to his 2025 pre-Derby billing; useful form but needs markedly better

races.race_name: Pertemps Network Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Ride The Thunder
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner who's been on the premises in all his five handicaps, albeit managing only sixth of 20 from midfield when clear favourite for the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (upped to 2m) last time on AW debut; no handicap win but he's been pretty reliable and this race is a lot less competitive.
runners.comment: 6th as clear favourite in the Northumberland Plate; no handicap win but pretty reliable

runners.name: Team Player
runners.spotlight: With tongue-tie enlisted he's hit major new heights for new yard this year, with two wins preceding his excellent fifth of 15 in the 2m2f Chester Cup; comes from off the pace but never got seriously involved wearing first-time cheekpieces when ninth of 20 as second favourite in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m); needs to bounce back from that pretty disappointing show.
runners.comment: Needs to bounce back from a modest show as second favourite in the Northumberland Plate

runners.name: Shrimp Shady
runners.spotlight: Pretty consistent in seven AW runs and well backed when leading final 1f to win the 17-runner Chester Plate (2m2f, good) in May on return to turf; failed to live up to favouritism in another consolation race at Newcastle (2m Vase, AW) three weeks ago but that sixth of 20 off this mark was his best form, so he remains one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Won the Chester Plate (2m2f, good) and good sixth of 20 in Northumberland Vase (2m, AW)

runners.name: Almuhit
runners.spotlight: Made most for two game wins in four-runner C&D races (good to firm) last summer, latterly in this race off 2lb higher than today; second to Baileys Khelstar over C&D on latest outing was in just a three-runner race but easily his best Flat effort this year, so he could be on his way back.
runners.comment: Won this last year off 2lb higher; 2nd to Baileys Khelstar and could be on his way back

runners.name: Baileys Khelstar
runners.spotlight: Gained a deserved first success of the season in three-runner handicap over C&D (good to firm; from Almuhit) last month and got up close home in nine-runner race at Kempton (2m, AW) ten days ago; up 3lb to career-high mark but he's on a roll.
runners.comment: On a roll, having won last two starts over C&D (good to firm) and at Kempton
runners.owner: Baileys Horse Feeds (F H Nash Ltd)

runners.name: Bahadur
runners.spotlight: Progressive on AW last autumn and he's been a bit better this season too; won five-runner race at Goodwood (upped to 2m, good) in May and, having been mid-division at Royal Ascot (2m4f), made most when fifth of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m, AW); in the mix.
runners.comment: Won at Goodwood (up to 2m) in May and made most when fifth of 20 in Northumberland Plate
runners.owner: J William Rowley & S P C Woods

runners.name: Duraji
runners.spotlight: Only 1-10 for Dermot Weld but was highly tried on occasions; made most from wide draw in major handicaps on both starts for Richard Hughes, reeled in late on when third in the Chester Cup (2m2f, good) but backpedalling before the home straight at Royal Ascot (1m6f, good to firm); big shout if he reverts to the Chester performance.
runners.comment: Made most from wide draw when third in Chester Cup and well beaten at Royal Ascot (1m6f)

races.race_name: Hallgarten And Novum Wines Hackwood Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Soldier's Tree
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 5yo who has low mileage and progressive form; record since switched to turf and dropped to 6f reads 233; has performed well in Listed event at Salisbury and the Wokingham at Royal Ascot for new yard; already very useful and warrants respect with further progress plausible.
runners.comment: Ran well in the Wokingham last time; respected with further progress plausible

runners.name: Binhareer
runners.spotlight: Broadly progressive 4yo whose form in notable handicaps suggests he could develop into a Group horse; went close on reappearance in his bid for a York double, then finished a respectable sixth when favourite for the Wokingham at Royal Ascot; remains of major interest.
runners.comment: Form in notable handicaps suggests he could develop into a Group horse

runners.name: Symbol Of Honour
runners.spotlight: Still below best when third at Newcastle (AW debut) last time but that was something of resurgence; progressive spell culminated in wins over C&D (Listed) and at Haydock (Group 2) in May 2025; possibilities provided he returns to that sort of form.
runners.comment: Possibilities on peak form, namely two wins (including over C&D) in May 2025

runners.name: Song Of The Clyde
runners.spotlight: Sole 3yo in this field; largely progressive colt whose form features wins in York sales race as a 2yo and C&D Listed event on penultimate outing; creditable seventh in the Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot latest; may have more to offer back down in class; major player.
runners.comment: Largely progressive colt; scored over C&D on penultimate start; major player
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Cxx & M Parker

runners.name: Noble Champion
runners.spotlight: Clear best in the 2025 Jersey at Royal Ascot (7f) but was pulled up (lost action) in only subsequent start last term and has failed to show his form this year; drop back to 6f had no effect last time; enough to prove.
runners.comment: 2025 Jersey winner; has failed to show his form this year

runners.name: Jasour
runners.spotlight: Has an underwhelming strike-rate for a horse of his ability and losing spell goes back over two years; that said, has spent over half of his career in Group 1 races, best effort when third in the 2024 Commonwealth Cup; drops back in class after a heavy defeat at this year's Royal Ascot.
runners.comment: Has an underwhelming strike-rate; losing spell goes back over two years

runners.name: Mitbaahy
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced in recent times but latest effort, namely fifth in the Wokingham, suggests he retains a very useful level of ability aged seven; however, needs to prove he's still capable of peak form, which includes Group wins at Newbury and the Curragh.
runners.comment: Formerly smart but needs to prove he's still capable of peak form

races.race_name: Weatherbys Super Sprint Stakes (GBBRace)

runners.name: Vollering
runners.spotlight: Represents a trainer who landed this prize in 2022; campaigned non-domestically since scoring at Redcar on debut; ran well in French Listed races (5f) the last twice, good third at Deauville latest occasion; major contender provided that form is transferred back to home soil.
runners.comment: Major contender provided his French Listed form is transferred back to home soil

runners.name: Bint Archange
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival at Royal Ascot but is a progressive 5f filly otherwise and registered a half-length success in Sandown Listed event (good) most recently, taking record to 2-4; sole attempt under William Buick resulted in the earlier win; leading player even with a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Largely progressive filly; bagged Listed honours at Sandown last time; leading player

runners.name: Bill The Bull
runners.spotlight: Ran as if something perhaps went amiss when co-favourite for the Sandown Listed contest won by Bint Archange last time; now goes in tongue-tie and may resume the steady progress that culminated in a Bath maiden success (5.7f, good); remains of interest.
runners.comment: Best to forgive latest effort; now goes in tongue-tie; may resume his progress

runners.name: Rollthedicebaby
runners.spotlight: Has shown significant promise in Goodwood races, finishing second over 5f (good) then going one better in clearcut fashion over 6f (soft); open to further improvement and is the Hannon first string on form and jockey arrangements; yard has a great record in this race; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Clearcut success in latest Goodwood start; yard has a great record in this race

runners.name: Seed Ya Later
runners.spotlight: Has failed to show progress in two starts since prevailing narrowly at Musselburgh (5f); fitting of hood needs to have a major effect on these difficult terms.
runners.comment: Fitting of hood needs to have a major effect on these difficult terms

runners.name: Kodi Bear Light
runners.spotlight: Similar type to stablemate Final Appeal, being a thrice-raced contender who proved disappointing when last seen; however, made all at Thirsk (5f, good) the time before and may still do better; rating suggests she's no forlorn hope at the weights.
runners.comment: Disappointing when last seen but may still do better; no forlorn hope at the weights

runners.name: Call Me Tomorrow
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden whose form includes a couple of second-place finishes but who hasn't progressed and still needs to learn to relax, having failed to settle when posting her lesser efforts.
runners.comment: Hasn't progressed and still needs to learn to settle better

runners.name: Leucothea
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who has consistent form but played second fiddle in a Goodwood seller (5f) most recently and looks well out of her depth in this much deeper company.
runners.comment: Played second fiddle in seller most recently; out of her depth in this company

runners.name: Etienne
runners.spotlight: By a Coventry winner for his connections; posted a promising effort in tight finish at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) where he split a couple of rivals who had the benefit of experience; one of the bigger players at the weights and has possibilities with progress on the cards.
runners.comment: Posted a promising effort at Newmarket; progress looks on the cards; possibilities

runners.name: Wait Geordie
runners.spotlight: Won on debut then ran well when favourite for the Lily Agnes at Chester; however, his form has dipped markedly in two starts since, gelded prior to nursery defeat latest; huge turnaround is required.
runners.comment: Won on debut then ran well in the Lily Agnes; form has dipped markedly since

runners.name: Final Appeal
runners.spotlight: Absent and gelded since a rather disappointing effort in the Lily Agnes at Chester, failing to back up April promise that featured a comfortable win at Wolverhampton (5f, AW); something to prove.
runners.comment: Absent and gelded since a rather disappointing effort in the Lily Agnes at Chester

runners.name: Zigazig Ah
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism with something to spare at Yarmouth (good to firm) in latest 6f start, building on her debut promise; gives the impression she'll be as effective over 5f and should have more to offer; helps to give her connections, who also run Etienne, an interesting hand.
runners.comment: Yarmouth scorer who helps to give her connections an interesting hand

runners.name: Angels Lane
runners.spotlight: Harry Angel filly who is hitherto her trainer's only 2yo runner this year and bids to take her record to 2-2; won only an ordinary maiden at Chepstow (5f, soft) but is open to progress and gets in here off an attractive weight; one to consider.
runners.comment: Trainer's only 2yo runner this year; won at Chepstow; looks open to progress

runners.name: Clueisinthetitle
runners.spotlight: Finished last in the Chepstow race won by Angels Lane, then registered a modest third at Brighton; plenty to find.
runners.comment: Modest third last time; plenty to find

runners.name: Past Passion
runners.spotlight: Maintained consistency by finishing a good second to Holi Scarlett in Nottingham nursery last time; however, both fillies face a markedly tougher task in this field.
runners.comment: Proving consistent but faces a tougher task in this field

runners.name: Sky Secret
runners.spotlight: Started favourite for two Leicester maidens (5f, good to firm) in the spring, making all and nicely on top at the finish last time; comes back fresh for a crack at this bigger prize, looks likely to show further improvement and represents a trainer who has a growing tally in sales races; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Leicester winner who should improve further; trainer has a growing tally in sales races

runners.name: Ballisty
runners.spotlight: Proving consistent, as a series of placed efforts reflect; however, chance of overcoming a difficult task at the weights depends on the effects of first-time headgear and return to 5f for first time since debut.
runners.comment: Chance depends on the effects of first-time headgear and return to 5f

runners.name: Niewiadoma
runners.spotlight: Won at Thirsk (5f) on debut; down the field in notable races since, latest at Royal Ascot, and still needs to prove she's capable of progress; however, these terms may enable her to prove resurgent.
runners.comment: Down the field in notable races since Thirsk win but may be resurgent on these terms

runners.name: Nascent Star
runners.spotlight: Has posted similar efforts in 5f novice events, finishing fourth both times, latest at Windsor; a nursery would have been more suitable than this assignment, as a mark of 65 reflects.
runners.comment: Has plenty to find on his fourth-place finishes at novice level

runners.name: Holi Scarlett
runners.spotlight: Ran creditably at Yarmouth last week when bidding for a 5f nursery double; beat Past Passion at Nottingham the time before; remains in form but faces a much stiffer assignment on these terms.
runners.comment: Remains in form but faces a much stiffer assignment on these terms

runners.name: Minster Boy
runners.spotlight: Gained valuable experience for a scenario of this nature by finishing second in big field at Newbury (6f, good to firm; well-supported favourite) last week, backing up the promise of his eye-catching effort at Windsor (5f); still open to progress and looks likely to go well.
runners.comment: Finished second in big field at Newbury last week; looks likely to go well

runners.name: Holliesthedollie
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who posted clear best effort in sole AW attempt; has something to prove and a lot to find.
runners.comment: Posted clear best effort in sole AW attempt

runners.name: Seathegulls
runners.spotlight: Gradually getting the hang of things but RPRs in the 50s reflect that he holds modest claims in this field and would have been more interesting in a low-grade handicap.
runners.comment: Getting the hang of things but holds modest form claims

runners.name: From Me To You
runners.spotlight: Faces a stiff task off top weight in this field, based on his spring form; however, may improve for physical tweak (gelded since last run) and he represents a yard that has an excellent record in the Super Sprint; market support should be heeded.
runners.comment: Faces a stiff task on form but may improve for physical tweak (gelded since last run)

runners.name: Courage Best
runners.spotlight: Gives the impression she may benefit from this drop in distance but not the rise in grade; holds very weak claims on her 6f form.
runners.comment: Holds very weak claims on her 6f form

races.race_name: Darley EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Miss Scott
runners.spotlight: 650,000gns yearling by Night Of Thunder; readily made a winning debut at Leicester (7f, good to soft) last September; 5-4 favourite when hooded for a novice here (1m1f, good to soft) five weeks ago and always prominent before losing out by half a length; that rival was making her debut but Miss Scott is weighted to turn the tables today.
runners.comment: Won 2yo debut; lost out to newcomer Manaar here (1m1f) in June but weighted to turn tables

runners.name: Manaar
runners.spotlight: 370,000gns yearling by St Mark's Basilica, half-sister to the stable's prolific winner Dubai Honour (1m-1m4f including Group 1); 8-1 for novice here (1m1f, good to soft) five weeks ago, coming from midfield to beat Miss Scott by half a length as the pair drew clear; 7lb worse off with that rival today but that debut win for this filly was full of promise.
runners.comment: 8-1 here (1m1f, good to soft) for debut win from Miss Scott; 7lb worse off but promising

runners.name: Aura Champagne
runners.spotlight: 110,000gns yearling by Dark Angel; 17-2 from 11-1 for a conditions stakes here (7f, good to soft) last September when a close third of seven, always prominent; that was a bright start against fairly useful opposition, which earns respect despite her coming from a speedy family.
runners.comment: Close third here (7f) last September was a bright start against fairly useful opposition

runners.name: Aunt Roberta
runners.spotlight: 85,000euros yearling by Sea The Stars; 80-1 and never dangerous in novice here (1m1f, good to soft) five weeks ago; should improve but she has about 9l to find with Manaar and Miss Scott.
runners.comment: Should improve but she was about 9l behind Manaar and Miss Scott on debut last month

runners.name: Scarlet Letter
runners.spotlight: 33-1 when sixth of seven at Nottingham (1m, good to soft) in October and last of four at Lingfield (1m2f, good) this May; early days but that's modest maiden form.
runners.comment: Early days but modest maiden form in October and May in her two starts

races.race_name: Back The Super Boost At BetVictor EBF Novice Stakes (Colts & Geldings) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: California School
runners.spotlight: 150,000euros foal, 90,000gns yearling, 140,000gns (brreeze-up) 2yo; Starspangledbanner half-brother to four winners, notably Harrow (Group-placed 6.5f-7.3f 2yo; RPR 102); dam 5f AW winner (67); interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: 140,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; by Starspangledbanner; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Satellite Of Love
runners.spotlight: Incurs 4lb penalty for a Windsor success (6f, good to firm; made all) that hasn't worked out well but brings upside, being a once-raced colt who is in good hands and may progress.
runners.comment: Incurs 4lb penalty for a Windsor win that hasn't worked out well but may show progress
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xvii & M Parker

runners.name: Can't Stop
runners.spotlight: Finished second of four in Yarmouth maiden (6f, good to firm) won by fellow newcomer who was odds-on and looks a useful prospect; respected assuming he builds on that promise.
runners.comment: Finished second of four, behind useful prospect, in Yarmouth maiden; respected

runners.name: Agrippa
runners.spotlight: Naval Crown colt who showed promise with close fifth of 11 at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) having attracted support; possibilities with progress on the cards.
runners.comment: Showed promise with close fifth of 11 at Doncaster having attracted support; possibilities

runners.name: Sayid Harry Angel
runners.spotlight: 11,000gns foal, 60,000gns yearling; Harry Angel half-brother to six winners. notably Hoodwinker (1m-1m2f inc AW 2yo; RPR 92); dam unraced; notable connections; heed the market signals.
runners.comment: 60,000gns yearling; by Harry Angel; notable connections; heed the market signals

runners.name: Baddaddan
runners.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; by Mehmas and first foal of Listed-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner (RPR 94), from family of top miler Attraction; stablemate of once-raced Can't Stop; market instructive.
runners.comment: 100,000gns yearling; by Mehmas; stablemate of Can't Stop; market instructive

runners.name: Chief Minister
runners.spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; Mattmu half-brother to two winners, notably Anaisa (5f/6f 2yo including Listed; RPR 80); dam 1m1f winner (78); the stable second string on jockey arrangements.
runners.comment: 55,000gns yearling; by Mattmu; the stable second string on jockey arrangements

runners.name: First Mate
runners.spotlight: 27,000euros foal, 55,000euros yearling; Naval Crown half-brother to three winners, notably Romanovich (7f-8.6f; RPR 67); dam maiden (75); yard first string on jockey arrangements; betting may give further guidance.
runners.comment: 55,000euros yearling; by Naval Crown; seems the stable first string

runners.name: Untouchable
runners.spotlight: 120,000euros yearling, 370,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; by Too Darn Hot; sibling to winners in Poland and Sweden; dam unraced, out of Oaks/King George winner Taghrooda; looks the pick of the debutants.
runners.comment: 370,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; by Too Darn Hot; looks the pick of the debutants

runners.name: Rapid Deployment
runners.spotlight: Brings the worst form, having finished last of seven in 6f contest on the turf course at Lingfield; gelded since; perhaps best watched unless the market suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: Last of seven in Lingfield contest; gelded since

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Velvet Rhythm
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism in another Class 5 event last week, taking Catterick record to 3-3 and strike-rate since handicapping to 4-6; Newmarket win shows she's versatile as regards track; upped in class but receives weight all round and possibly hasn't stopped improving yet.
runners.comment: Latest win took her Catterick record to 3-3 and strike-rate since handicapping to 4-6
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Lightning Polka
runners.spotlight: Has a record of 0-5 since debut success (6f) but she ran encouragingly upped in trip and fitted with a hood at Newmarket (good to firm) most recently; may build on that effort kept to 7f in the retained headgear; now 5lb lower than her opening mark; respected.
runners.comment: Ran encouragingly upped to 7f and fitted with hood last time; may build on that effort
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: All Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Hindered by unfavourable draw (fared best in her group) at Royal Ascot last time; progressive on AW otherwise, posting form figures of 3111, and may still have more to offer; remains of interest, assuming she can prove as effective on turf.
runners.comment: Progressive on AW prior to being poorly drawn (fared best in her group) at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Brisk Symphony
runners.spotlight: Effective over 6f as a 2yo (won at Newbury) but the return to that distance backfired last time; good second in a couple of 7f contests otherwise this season and remains less exposed over this trip; possibilities.
runners.comment: Good second in both 7f attempts; less exposed at this trip than at shorter

runners.name: New Vega
runners.spotlight: Absent since running creditably in valuable race at Deauville (6.5f) last August; won easily at Doncaster (7f) the time before; still unexposed and looks interesting on reappearance, especially if the market speaks positively.
runners.comment: Still unexposed; looks interesting on reappearance, especially if strong in the betting

runners.name: Tavana
runners.spotlight: Not particularly solid on her 1m form this term but wasn't entirely disgraced at Royal Ascot on penultimate start; appears likely to benefit from this drop back in trip/class and return to the scene of one of her 2yo wins; could go well.
runners.comment: Likely to benefit from this drop back in trip/class and return to Newbury; could go well

races.race_name: Betway Free Bet Club Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Master Haku
runners.spotlight: Progressive form over shorter, winning a maiden over an extended 2m at Kilbeggan (good to yielding); weakened over 2m4f next time and then ran poorly at 3m; strong form claims if he can prove himself over this far.
runners.comment: Progressive form over shorter; strong form claims if he can prove himself over this far

runners.name: Loriko
runners.spotlight: Doubly penalised for winning a match at Huntingdon (2m4f145yds) and a weak race at Uttoxeter (2m; again on good), since when he's undergone wind surgery; hasn't been beating a lot but he's probably progressive.
runners.comment: Hasn't been beating a lot but he's probably progressive; had a wind operation
runners.owner: Cherry Knoll Farm, M Ward & D Skelton

runners.name: Nobotheratall
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who made all in a Kelso novice hurdle (2m, good); came up shy under a penalty at Hexham but was clear of the rest in chasing home the odds-on favourite; steps up in distance this afternoon.
runners.comment: Came up shy under a penalty last time but he was beaten by the odds-on favourite

runners.name: Show Your Hand
runners.spotlight: Went close in two bumpers and was pulled up sharply on hurdle debut when jockey felt something was amiss; has since left David Pipe; bred to improve for this longer distance but he needs to.
runners.comment: Twice second in bumpers; bred to improve for this longer distance but he needs to

runners.name: Arcimboldo
runners.spotlight: 0-11 on the Flat and has been contesting low-grade handicaps at about 2m; unlikely to be winning this on hurdle debut.
runners.comment: 0-11 on the Flat and has been contesting low-grade handicaps at about 2m

runners.name: Ballinoulart
runners.spotlight: 0-22 in points and now 0-18 under rules (0-14 over fences) after finishing a tailed-off runner-up in a novice hurdle at Newton Abbot.
runners.comment: Maiden in points and under rules; achieved nothing when second last time out

races.race_name: Betway Summer Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Louis Veron
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 5yo who makes his handicap debut after easy odds-on wins on good ground at Warwick and Stratford, posting an eye-catching RPR last time when barely put through the gears; could easily be on a lenient mark.
runners.comment: Posted a smart RPR last time and could easily be on a good mark for this handicap debut

runners.name: Howth
runners.spotlight: Record of 4-7 over hurdles but this is tougher than usual and he could have run a lot better back from a break at Newton Abbot; others appeal more.
runners.comment: He could have run a lot better back from a break at Newton Abbot

runners.name: Squeezebox
runners.spotlight: 1m4f winner who has gone 3-4 over hurdles for Tom Lacey and easily won on handicap debut last time at Southwell (good; second run in this headgear combination), albeit against only four rivals; up 8lb but has momentum behind him.
runners.comment: Up 8lb for winning a much weaker race but has momentum behind him

runners.name: High Fibre
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat performer and also 2-15 as a hurdler (regularly placed); left Harry Fry for £15,000 and was a 6l third over 1m4f at York on last week's stable debut (no headgear); first-time visored now (effective in tongue-tie/cheekpieces).
runners.comment: 2-15 over hurdles; 6l third over 1m4f at York on last week's stable debut

runners.name: Newtown Rambler
runners.spotlight: Front runner; 2-8 over hurdles and returns to this discipline off a good mark having completed a hat-trick over fences three weeks ago off 4lb higher; has found his best form since joining this yard in January and this track should suit him well.
runners.comment: Has recently completed a hat-trick over fences and on a good mark back hurdling

runners.name: Morning Mayhem
runners.spotlight: Contrasting performances at Newton Abbot last month, winning well but then finishing last of four; cheekpieces fitted for this much tougher test.
runners.comment: Modest latest effort and cheekpieces fitted for this much tougher test

runners.name: Indemnity
runners.spotlight: Best on good ground as he showed when running away with the Sussex Champion Hurdle at Plumpton in April; however, that came at a cost to the tune of 10lb and he failed to fire behind Moon Chime in the Swinton; others might be better in here.
runners.comment: Raised 10lb for winning the Sussex Champion Hurdle and failed to fire in the Swinton

runners.name: Mojito Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced winning hurdler in France; had a wind operation prior to posting career-best form when a fast-closing second at Ascot in March; up 4lb but has his age allowance now tackling his elders and also the assistance of Harry Cobden.
runners.comment: Up 4lb for career-best run at Ascot in March (second); respected with his age allowance

runners.name: Pigeon House
runners.spotlight: Changed hands in March after winning a claimer; only four ran when a half-length runner-up here a month ago; opposable at this level.
runners.comment: Only four ran when a half-length runner-up here a month ago

runners.name: Continuance
runners.spotlight: Three hurdle wins at around 2m; has been running well in defeat this summer (2m-2m4f), mostly in a hood but in no headgear last time; cheekpieces now added; others are more compelling.
runners.comment: Has been running well in defeat this summer; the cheekpieces are a first

runners.name: Charlus
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat form in France; after winning a maiden hurdle for Willie Mullins he was essentially disappointing under both codes and has got nothing going for Dan Skelton, with his latest run after wind surgery at Newton Abbot thoroughly underwhelming (8-1 and weak in the betting); very much the stable second string.
runners.comment: One-time useful but has got nothing going since joining Dan Skelton

runners.name: Letterston Lily
runners.spotlight: Back from a long absence to justify favouritism at Perth in April (2m4f, good) where she came from off the pace to hit the front when left clear at the last; up 6lb but consistent in the main and wouldn't be exposed just yet.
runners.comment: Won after a break in April and she wouldn't be exposed just yet; raised 6lb

runners.name: Moon Chime
runners.spotlight: 2-3 in bumpers and 5-11 over hurdles after leading late on in the Swinton (good); that was in a first-time tongue-tie that was also on when winning a 2m AW handicap in late May; off just 4lb higher than at Haydock, he's very much in the mix.
runners.comment: Has won on the Flat since leading late on in the Swinton; only 4lb higher for this
runners.owner: DL Adams, JA Adams & G McPherson

races.race_name: Betway Summer Plate Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Stans The Man
runners.spotlight: In a solid run of form but this is a tough mark for an exposed 9yo and he's undergone a fourth wind operation since finishing fifth at Perth in early June.
runners.comment: In a solid run of form but this is a tough mark for an exposed 9yo; another wind operation

runners.name: King Roly
runners.spotlight: Three wins at around 2m4f last season, all in small fields on good ground; after some blips he got himself back on track when second to a well-handicapped horse over C&D a month ago on first visit here; likely to run well with Shane Fenelon now taking off 5lb; one of three runners for a yard that's captured this eight times.
runners.comment: Runner-up to a well-handicapped horse here last month on his first visit here

runners.name: Kingston Narcissus
runners.spotlight: Clearcut winner on chase debut (2m4f, good) on final run for Rebecca Menzies and similar sort of form in defeat in two runs for the Skeltons, last time pushing earlier-race contender Newton Rambler all the way back over 2m at Uttoxeter; returning to further looks a plus and this hold-up performer should have this run to suit him.
runners.comment: Improving chaser who is held up in his races so this should be run to suit him

runners.name: Queensbury Boy
runners.spotlight: 1-7 over fences; gifted a walkover before finishing second in a four-runner handicap at Uttoxeter where he failed to fire when favourite for their Summer Cup 20 days ago; he's better than that and further progress is possible with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Better than he showed last time and further progress is possible with cheekpieces added

runners.name: Nickelforce
runners.spotlight: Consistent chaser who was better than ever in dominating a small field at Fakenham two runs back (2m5f185yds, good); didn't run badly in defeat last time and off a light weight he could have a part to play.
runners.comment: Career best two runs back and off a light weight he could have a part to play

runners.name: Riaan
runners.spotlight: His defeat of the smart Jesse Evans at Sligo in October heightens interest and new headgear is tried after two lesser efforts, particularly the latest; he has become hard to predict but it's unwise to put a line through him.
runners.comment: Has become hard to predict but it's unwise to put a line through him now in new headgear

runners.name: Breizh River
runners.spotlight: Win/placed form in his usual cheekpieces before making all for a narrow success in the newly fitted visor (with tongue-tie worn for last seven starts) at Cartmel (2m5f, good); he's getting high in the weights now (raised another 4lb) and he won't be the only one racing prominently.
runners.comment: Consistent last-time-out winner but he is getting high in the weights now

runners.name: Mahons Glory
runners.spotlight: Very capable prominent racer on his day and he had one of those in winning by 2l over C&D a month ago; 4lb rise elevates him to a career-high mark and he won't be the only one putting pace to the race.
runners.comment: On a career-high mark and he won't be the only one putting pace to the race
runners.owner: C Nightingale & Hold My Beer Partnership

runners.name: Pour Les Filles
runners.spotlight: Ex-Gordon Elliott; made a successful handicap chase debut for this yard at Ffos Las (2m3f, soft) in January but up and down since, with recent thirds just okay efforts (latest in this new headgear combination when behind Breizh River); may prefer softer ground ideally.
runners.comment: Recent thirds were just okay runs and he may prefer softer ground ideally

runners.name: Baltic Bird
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat and hurdles performer who has gone 0-5 over fences since a winning start in May 2025 and he'll need to run better than he did in a handicap chase at Ballinrobe last time; however, a case can be made off this mark on best form; versatile trip-wise from 2m to beyond 3m.
runners.comment: Irish raider below par last time but a case can be made off this mark on best form

runners.name: Soul Icon
runners.spotlight: Two good runs in defeat at 3m before coming down at the Canal Turn in the Topham Trophy; went close to winning this two years ago and that was after a two-month break; definite possibilities, as this mark isn't beyond him; Harry Cobden has won the last three renewals of this race.
runners.comment: In fair form earlier this year and able when fresh; second in this two years ago

runners.name: Gunsight Ridge
runners.spotlight: Wasn't disgraced in finishing third of six over 2m4f at Uttoxeter on stable debut but he's not as good as he was and an 11yo now.
runners.comment: Finished third on stable debut; he's not as good as he was and an 11yo now

runners.name: St Faz
runners.spotlight: Hurdle/chase winner who has won four times on the Flat since moving to current yard earlier this year; lacks recent match practice over jumps and that could count against him in this competitive a race.
runners.comment: Has been running well on the Flat but lacks recent match practice over jumps

races.race_name: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Hello Sweety
runners.spotlight: Small fields suit this free-going mare, as do sharp, flat tracks; perhaps on a fairly tough mark after coming up short last time but shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: On fairly tough mark after coming up short last time but shouldn't be far away

runners.name: Sun Art
runners.spotlight: No further progress since winning a 2m novice in March 2025; however, his mark is easing and last two runs (2m/2m4f) weren't too shoddy.
runners.comment: His mark is easing and last two runs (2m/2m4f) weren't too shoddy

runners.name: No More Bolero
runners.spotlight: Race-fit off the Flat when a battling winner over a little shorter at Worcester a month ago (visor back on) and looks a good thing to give his running once more off 4lb higher; respected.
runners.comment: Worcester winner who looks a good thing to give his running once more off 4lb higher

runners.name: Forest Spirit
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner who is 0-7 over hurdles; good first run in cheekpieces when second at Ffos Las (2m4f, good to soft) but never got involved the last time (2m6f); perhaps a fast-run race back at this distance will benefit her.
runners.comment: Has been running over further and perhaps a fast-run race back at this trip will benefit

runners.name: Jolie Coeur Allen
runners.spotlight: Only win in 12 hurdle starts was a maiden; likes to crack on with things and probably went off a bit too hot when a well-held fourth at Cartmel (2m1f; after 99 days off); has another front-runner to deal with in Hello Sweety, but the ability is there to win off this mark.
runners.comment: Ability respected; front-runner who probably went off a bit too hot last time

races.race_name: Read Paul Townend's Betway Blog Handicap Chase

runners.name: Catchim
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D handicap in April and was runner-up at Southwell last month but he's not easy to predict and was well below form at Stratford last time; that took his chase record to 1-15 and he needs to bounce back again.
runners.comment: C&D winner but he was well held at Stratford last time and is now 1-15 over fences

runners.name: Dream Jet
runners.spotlight: Triple chase winner including over C&D but he's been beaten 35l in both runs since returning from an absence in May; has something to prove and he needs a major revival.
runners.comment: C&D winner but he's been out of sorts since returning from an absence in May

runners.name: Huit Reflets
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner who scored over fences at Sedgefield (2m, good to soft) last December but he hasn't really fired in his last three runs; chase record is now 1-11 and others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: 1-11 over fences and hasn't really fired in last three runs; others are more persuasive

runners.name: Most Wanted
runners.spotlight: Flat winner who is 0-6 over hurdles but he won on chase debut at Fakenham (2m, good) in May before a creditable third at Uttoxeter 11 days ago; did well to hang in there after being pestered for the lead last time and he's been an improved performer since switched to fences; respected.
runners.comment: Won on chase debut at Fakenham before creditable third at Uttoxeter last month; respected

runners.name: Prospect House
runners.spotlight: Ended last year with a brave win at Catterick (1m7f, good to soft) but he's not gone on from that in two runs this summer; needs to raise his game but he's now only 1lb higher than for his last success and his first two chase wins were over C&D (good).
runners.comment: Needs to raise his game but he's on a workable mark and is a dual C&D winner
runners.owner: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing

runners.name: Mr McWhinny
runners.spotlight: 0-18 under rules but he was an easy winner of an Irish point in May; well held back over regulation fences at Uttoxeter (3m, good) last month but he took a strong hold and ran well to a point in that race; could benefit from this drop back in trip and it wouldn't be a surprise if he was in the mix.
runners.comment: Ran well to a point over 3m last time and he's not ruled out on this big drop back in trip

runners.name: Sledgehammer
runners.spotlight: Won an Irish point on yielding ground in March; struggled in hunter chases in next four runs but he was an eye-catching fourth on handicap debut at Wexford (2m3f, good) two weeks ago; needs to build on that but he's still lightly raced and should have more to offer in this sphere.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo who was an eye-catcher on handicap debut at Wexford; not ruled out

runners.name: Fox Wallace
runners.spotlight: Sole success was at Stratford (2m1f, good) last May and she's been out of sorts in her last seven starts; 5lb out of the weights this time and she has a lot to prove.
runners.comment: Sole win was 14 months ago and she's struggled in last seven runs; 5lb out of the weights
runners.owner: M Enticott / Ella Pickard Racing Club

races.race_name: Betway Boosts Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Special John
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-5 over fences when scoring at Bangor (3m, good) in May and he went very close behind his main market rival at Fontwell four weeks later; up another 2lb but he still looks on a workable mark and is open to more progress as a chaser; respected.
runners.comment: Record of 3-6 over fences and he went very close at Fontwell last time; respected

runners.name: Redbridge Rambler
runners.spotlight: Appreciated the step back up to 3m when winning at Warwick (good) in May but he was a well-held fourth when favourite at Worcester (2m7f) last month; has bit to prove again after that and this is competitive.
runners.comment: Cashed in on a reduced mark at Warwick in May but was well held at Worcester last time

runners.name: Sir Carnegie
runners.spotlight: 6yo who made it 4-10 over fences when completing a double with his late thrust at Hexham (3m, good) last month; up 3lb but he's been as good as ever in his last two starts and he's strong stayer as this trip; key player.
runners.comment: Made it 4-10 over fences when completing a double at Hexham (3m) last month; key player

runners.name: Yes Day
runners.spotlight: Career has had its ups and downs but he won two chases (3m1f and 3m6f) in March 2025 and he's been placed at Stratford (second of five) and Worcester (third of 11) in his last two runs; remains well treated off 10lb lower than his last success and he's in the mix back up in trip.
runners.comment: Back to form with placed efforts in last two runs and he remains well treated on old form

runners.name: Giovanni Change
runners.spotlight: Six of his nine wins have come at Market Rasen including over C&D; only 1lb higher than for his win at Wetherby in March but he's been vulnerable in three runs since and needs to rediscover his spark.
runners.comment: Market Rasen specialist but he needs to rediscover his spark
runners.owner: Readers & Wiggy, The 8 Amigos & J Burns

runners.name: You Did
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Hexham (2m4f, good) and Musselburgh (3m, soft) last season; only 1lb higher than for his last success but he's struggled in his last three runs and has something to prove on chase debut.
runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner but he's struggled in last three runs; bit to prove on chase debut

runners.name: Millena Agent
runners.spotlight: Just 1-11 in British points but she's shown some ability in novice/maiden hurdles this year; now makes her handicap/chase debut and she needs checking in market on this big step back up in trip.
runners.comment: Point winner and she needs checking in market on her handicap/chase debut

races.race_name: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Vivid Pink
runners.spotlight: Had a lengthy break after her breakthrough win but better than ever a month ago when breezing home off 9lb lower over C&D; something seems to have clicked.
runners.comment: Won her last two, the latest here very comfortably off 9lb lower; on the up

runners.name: Glory And Honour
runners.spotlight: Hard-fought win back over hurdles at Hexham (2m) before a 10l defeat returned to fences; no great significance in the return of cheekpieces (blinkered last two races) but entitled to have some say.
runners.comment: Hard-fought win back over hurdles at Hexham (2m) before a 10l defeat returned to fences

runners.name: Twist Of Fatecatch
runners.spotlight: Fontwell maiden winner last April; some good runs since in cheekpieces and the visor tried last time is soon dispensed with; could feature off what should be a good mark.
runners.comment: Has competitive form off higher marks; visor tried last time is soon dispensed with

runners.name: Prince Quattro
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner who was second in a Cheltenham handicap last October on final jumps run; 2lb lower now and he was a recent 2m winner at Newmarket; should go well.
runners.comment: Second in a Cheltenham handicap last October on final jumps run; recent Flat winner
runners.owner: Ursa Major Ltd & Hicky Parmar Racing

runners.name: Oneinthewell
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who is 0-9 over hurdles but has been bang there in his last two races, over C&D and 2m7f at Worcester; raised 3lb but he enters the reckoning.
runners.comment: 0-9 over hurdles but has been bang there in his last two races; raised 3lb

runners.name: Modern Style
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has run well in all four handicaps; may need another jolt of improvement to defy current mark but now tries cheekpieces.
runners.comment: May need another jolt of improvement to defy current mark but now tries cheekpieces

runners.name: Arnie Moon
runners.spotlight: 5lb higher than for his runaway win at Hereford (2m; handicap debut); fell early next time and then only fourth of the five runners at Worcester; probably needs his best yet here but it's still early days.
runners.comment: Hasn't kicked on from winning on handicap debut but it's still early days

runners.name: Mojo Ego
runners.spotlight: Joined Fergal O'Brien after finishing well beaten in a selling handicap; dropped to a good mark on best form and prevailed in a tight finish at Worcester 17 days ago (2m); respected off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Stable debut when prevailing in a tight finish at Worcester; respected off 4lb higher

runners.name: Belvedere Blast
runners.spotlight: All of his seven wins have been at either Hexham or here, so merits attention after finishing a close third at Uttoxeter a month ago; 2lb below last winning mark.
runners.comment: Goes well here so merits attention after finishing a close third at Uttoxeter

runners.name: Saxon Cross
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a bumper for former Irish yard; three heavy defeats in four runs for current one and was tailed off on handicap debut; has since had a wind operation and now goes in cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Three heavy defeats in four runs for current yard; had a wind op/tries cheekpieces

runners.name: Nottodaybobo
runners.spotlight: Has returned from a break in good form, winning back-to-back Class 5 handicaps at about 2m4f on good ground (the first here); remains on a fair mark but this is a better race and a competitive one.
runners.comment: Won last two; remains on a fair mark but this is a better race and a competitive one

runners.name: Ballygeary
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent 9yo who kept on for third at Uttoxeter (2m4f) without threatening; others preferred.
runners.comment: Inconsistent 9yo who kept on for third at Uttoxeter (2m4f) without threatening

races.race_name: Dobsons Gaskets EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Warby
runners.spotlight: Built upon her debut second at Catterick (5f, good to firm) when easily making all there (5f, good to firm) last Wednesday; she could have more left in the tank and holds leading claims under a penalty.
runners.comment: Easily made all at Catterick on second start and holds leading claims under a penalty

runners.name: Quillan
runners.spotlight: Belied 28-1 odds to win on debut at Redcar (5f, good) four weeks ago; his stable is not known for first-time-out 2yo winners so this £80,000 yearling could have a very bright future; major player under a penalty.
runners.comment: Belied 28-1 odds to win on debut at Redcar and could have a very bright future
runners.owner: Mrs Anne Atkinson And H D Atkinson

runners.name: Inca Warrior
runners.spotlight: 12-1 when fourth of seven, beaten just over 8l, on debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; others have much better form but he's a close relation to a useful sprinter and his trainer's 2yos can improve upon a bundle for their first starts; he's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Others have much better form but trainer's 2yos can improve a bundle for their first runs

runners.name: By Jove Grace
runners.spotlight: £70,000 breeze-up buy who was 18-1 for last month's debut at Carlisle but showed promise to finish second of four; she could be sharper for that experience and it will be no surprise if she's in the mix.
runners.comment: Second of four on debut at Carlisle and could be sharper for that experience
runners.owner: Mpr, A & Glo Outlaw & K Quinn

runners.name: Influencer Man
runners.spotlight: £50,000 breeze-up buy who showed promise and pace when 16-1 and beaten just over 1l in last of four on recent debut at Ayr (6f, good); this half-brother to four winners is open to improvement and could be a contender.
runners.comment: Close fourth of four on debut; this half-brother to four winners is open to improvement

races.race_name: Simon's 20 Year Heart Transplant Anniversary Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Black Orchid
runners.spotlight: Encouraging second on debut over C&D (good) in May and built on that when again finishing runner-up at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm); this well-bred filly could continue to progress and she's a leading contender.
runners.comment: Runner-up on both starts & this well-bred filly could continue to progress; leading claims

runners.name: Indefensible
runners.spotlight: Beaten eight times and the drop back to 6f isn't an obvious positive, but he's run some good races and was third in a handicap at Catterick (7f, good to firm) last Wednesday; prominent in calculations.
runners.comment: 0-8 and further may be preferable but some good form and he's prominent in calculations

runners.name: Stoneacre Joe
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on his first two starts this season (6f, good to firm) and a good case can be made on that form; however, he's gone off the boil on his three outings since and needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice in a row in the spring but he's gone off the boil subsequently

runners.name: Valor Spirit
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in C&D handicap (good) in May on stable/seasonal debut and that form puts him in the picture; however, disappointing at Redcar (5f, good) since and now 0-10; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Runner-up in C&D handicap in May but disappointing at Redcar since; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Master Of Delphi
runners.spotlight: He has a useful pedigree and cost 150,000euros at the breeze-ups last May; well-beaten last of five at 66-1 on debut at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) last month but he made the running in a hotter race than this; drops back in trip and interesting to see if he's stronger in the betting.
runners.comment: 150,000euros breeze-up buy; well beaten at 66-1 on debut; the betting may be interesting

races.race_name: Ripon Bell-Ringer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Yafreh
runners.spotlight: 3yo who has improved with each of his four starts and finished a close second of five on handicap debut at Thirsk (1m4f, good to firm) this month; the winner has followed up and this progressive colt could play a leading role following a 1lb rise.
runners.comment: Close second on handicap debut at Thirsk this month and the winner has followed up

runners.name: Salamanca City
runners.spotlight: 5yo mare whose form has gone to a new level this season, with wins at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) and Goodwood (1m4f, good to soft) sandwiching a runner-up finish at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm); she may be the type who only just does enough and therefore she could have more still left in the tank.
runners.comment: 2-3 and may be the type who only just does enough; could still have more left in the tank

runners.name: Spioradalta
runners.spotlight: Down the field at York and Windsor on his last two starts but he's won on his last four visits to Ripon (1m2f, good/good to soft), including twice this year; it's surprising he's only ever had one crack at 1m4f, given how well he kept on over that trip in 2024; firmly in calculations back here.
runners.comment: Below par elsewhere on last two starts but he's won on his last four visits to Ripon

runners.name: Elsass
runners.spotlight: Disappointing at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago but prior to that he was 2-2 since being gelded, with convincing wins at Southwell (1m3f, AW) and Hamilton (1m3f, good); could bounce back.
runners.comment: Disappointing last time but prior to that he was 2-2 since being gelded; could bounce back

runners.name: Prince Of The Seas
runners.spotlight: He's edged down the weights for his new yard this season and has been placed off this mark on his last two starts, finishing third at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) then beaten just a neck at Hamilton (1m5f, good); back up in grade this afternoon but he might not be far away.
runners.comment: Placed off this mark on last two starts; back up in grade but might not be far away

runners.name: Haku
runners.spotlight: Ten-time AW winner who is 5lb lower than when winning at Southwell (1m4f, AW) last November; however, this is his first run since January and he was well beaten at Ascot in May 2024 on his last encounter with turf; 0-5 on grass and others have less to prove.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on AW form but something to prove on turf and he lacks a recent run

runners.name: Per Contra
runners.spotlight: He's won just one of his last 23 starts and has failed to fire on his last two outings; however, he had a tough assignment in the John Smith's Cup at York last Saturday and he's dropped to a handy mark; runner-up to the 4-7 favourite in this race last year and he's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Has failed to fire on last two starts but handy mark and he was second in this last year

runners.name: Star Harbour
runners.spotlight: 8yo who has been beaten 23 times since his last win in September 2024 and failed to threaten at the Curragh three weeks ago; however, prior to that this Irish raider was second at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) behind a subsequent Royal Ascot winner, and he's in the picture on that form.
runners.comment: 8yo whose losing run continues but this Irish raider is in the picture on penultimate form

races.race_name: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap

runners.name: Qitaal
runners.spotlight: 7yo whose losing sequence goes back 21 races to September 2024 but he went close behind Yermanthere over C&D (good) last month and was a good third at Ayr (1m2f, good) last time; might not be far away.
runners.comment: 7yo whose losing sequence continues but he's shown some good form this summer

runners.name: Wild Violet
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in May on second start and won a novice at Salisbury (1m2f, good) last month; her latest form looks solid and this unexposed handicap newcomer could continue to progress; player.
runners.comment: 3yo handicap newcomer who won at Salisbury last month and could continue to progress

runners.name: Yermanthere
runners.spotlight: 8yo who capitalised on a reduced mark to win over C&D (good) last month before 7l second to easy winner in amateur jockeys' race at Pontefract (1m2f, good); he's not ruled out back here.
runners.comment: Won over C&D last month then 7l second in amateurs' race; not ruled out back here

runners.name: Poet's Dawn
runners.spotlight: 11yo who has been up and down this season but has won twice, including over C&D (good), and he ran pretty well when third here (1m, good) last time; finished third in this last year and he could give a good account.
runners.comment: 11yo who has been up and down this year but has won twice, including over C&D

runners.name: Lucky Hero
runners.spotlight: Often ran well in 2yo campaign and he got off the mark on his reappearance in a novice at Redcar (7f, good to firm); it's possible he'll stay this far but there is a question mark on that score, and also one about his current form as he's been well beaten on handicaps on his last two starts.
runners.comment: 3yo who arrives with questions to answer regarding stamina and his current form

runners.name: Midnight Strike
runners.spotlight: Capitalised on a golden opportunity for easy win at 8-13 in a seller at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; that may have given his confidence a boost and he's unexposed in the retained tongue-tie/cheekpieces, but he's opposable on what he's achieved in handicaps this season.
runners.comment: Won a seller at Beverley a fortnight ago but opposable on this season's handicap form
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

races.race_name: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap

runners.name: Garden Oasis
runners.spotlight: 11yo who needs to produce more than he's managed on his last three starts but he's 3lb lower than when a close third at Ayr (1m, good to firm) in May and has won at Ripon seven times; went close here in August 2024 when he last wore these blinkers (which replace cheekpieces); not discounted.
runners.comment: 11yo who needs to find something extra but this seven-time course winner is not discounted

runners.name: Cadarn
runners.spotlight: Returned to form to make all at 28-1 at York (1m, good) three weeks ago in a reapplied tongue-tie (retained); strong claims up 3lb if he can back up that latest performance.
runners.comment: Returned to form to make all at York; strong claims if he can back up that performance

runners.name: Jimmy Speaking
runners.spotlight: Kicked off this campaign with two wins in a row (7f, good to soft/AW) before solid second at Newmarket (1m, good); didn't run badly in mid-division in Class 2 at Epsom (8.5f, good to soft) last time and he could be in the mix back down in grade.
runners.comment: In fine form in the spring and didn't run badly in higher grade than this at Epsom latest

runners.name: Ben Lawers
runners.spotlight: Won 1m AW maiden at Dundalk in February but not at the top of his game on final two runs for Jessica Harrington and well beaten at 28-1 on stable debut at York three weeks ago; he may be best watched.
runners.comment: 1m AW maiden winner at Dundalk but needs to raise his game on this second stable start

runners.name: Jesmond Dawn
runners.spotlight: In good heart this season and he returned to winning ways over C&D (good) last Monday; a 5lb rise takes this 5yo to a career-high mark but he has a solid record here and could be firmly in the shake-up once more.
runners.comment: C&D win last Monday; up 5lb to a career-high mark but he has a solid record here

runners.name: Farasi Lane
runners.spotlight: Three-time turf winner who won two in a row at Wolverhampton (8.6f/7f, AW) in March and is 1lb below his last winning mark; he ran okay on his final few starts for the Newland/Insole yard but this 8yo needs something extra on today's stable debut, following 8,500gns sale.
runners.comment: He's run okay on his last few starts but needs something extra on today's stable debut

runners.name: Sir Paul Ramsey
runners.spotlight: Two wins last summer and he showed spark as recently as this April; he's dropped to a dangerous mark but has failed to shine on his last three outings and arrives with something to prove.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but he's failed to shine on his last three outings

races.race_name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Handicap

runners.name: Trucial Pearl
runners.spotlight: Built on some encouraging spring form to get off the mark at the 12th attempt in a C&D handicap (good) last month, beating a runner-up who won his next two; unplaced favourite in Thirsk classified (1m, good to firm) on Thursday but was caught wide; might be worth another chance.
runners.comment: Off mark at the 12th attempt over C&D last month; caught wide when unplaced on Thursday

runners.name: Mohmentous
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row this spring (1m, firm/good) and has continued in good heart, finishing second of three at Bath (1m, firm) then third of nine at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm); shaped last time as though he may benefit from the return to 1m and he could be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Won two in a row this spring and has continued in good heart; could be thereabouts

runners.name: Singarda
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago when fifth of seven in first-time cheekpieces (retained); however, he probably needs more help from the handicapper before he posts his first win.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly at Beverley but probably needs more help from the handicapper
runners.owner: D Bishop, S Bland & T Coyle

runners.name: Vega's Virtue
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) in May in first-time cheekpieces (retained since); pulled hard when 7l third at Leicester (1m, good) next time and down the field at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) most recently, but the return to Ripon could trigger a revival.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in May; two lesser runs since but return to Ripon could trigger a revival

runners.name: Sovereign Bright
runners.spotlight: Ran okay on her first two starts this season and has dropped down the weights but she's struggled on her last three runs; major turnaround needed in a first-time hood (replacing the cheekpieces adopted last time).
runners.comment: Has dropped down the weights but she's struggled on her last three starts; headgear change

runners.name: Balmoral Boy
runners.spotlight: It's still early days and there's potential in his pedigree; market check advised but he's finished well beaten in both handicaps and needs to be an entirely different proposition today.
runners.comment: Well beaten in both handicaps and needs to be an entirely different proposition today

runners.name: Aurelune
runners.spotlight: Improved upon her previous form when dropped back in trip at Leicester (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago, finishing third; this attractively bred filly could have more to offer and is a possible contender.
runners.comment: Improved form when third at Leicester and this well-bred filly could have more to offer

runners.name: Sparkling Pink
runners.spotlight: Ran well for a long way in front before fading into fourth when upped to 1m at Redcar (good) four weeks ago; it's possible she'd benefit from the return to 7f but is not ruled out today.
runners.comment: Faded into fourth at Redcar on first crack at 1m but ran well and she's not ruled out

runners.name: Delevingne Dream
runners.spotlight: Triple-figure odds on all three starts; down the field on first two outings and same story at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) last month after a break, but there were signs of ability that day; this half-sister to Group 3 winner Making Dreams goes handicapping off a modest mark and it will be no surprise if she plays a leading role, especially if strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Signs of ability at Yarmouth last time and goes handicapping off modest mark; watch market

races.race_name: Aldwark Manor Estate Luxury Yorkshire Hotel 'Confined' Handicap (Which Have Not Won A Race In 2026)

runners.name: Mister Sky Blue
runners.spotlight: Just one win from his 22 starts and merely mid-division at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last time in first-time blinkers (retained); however, he's twice finished runner-up this season and is not ruled out.
runners.comment: Poor strike-rate and merely mid-division last time, but twice runner-up this season

runners.name: Get Up Everybody
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden who has been expensive to follow and underwhelming on his last two starts; however, his season began with two positive performances in the spring and he's in the picture if rediscovering that form.
runners.comment: 0-13 and underwhelming on last two starts but in the picture on his best efforts this term

runners.name: Indy's Angel
runners.spotlight: Her 22 starts have yielded just one win but she was a close second of 18 at 25-1 at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) two starts ago and backed that up when runner-up to at Catterick (7f, good to firm) last Wednesday, albeit no match for the thriving winner; firmly in calculations given recent showings.
runners.comment: She's run well to be second on her last two starts and is therefore firmly in calculations

runners.name: Long Shot
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden who wasn't quite at his best when fourth of nine over C&D (good) last week but was in good form previously, coming second at Redcar (7f, good) in May and at Catterick (6f, good to firm) last month; chance.
runners.comment: Not quite at his best over C&D last week but in good form previously; might have a chance

runners.name: Act Of Violence
runners.spotlight: He's regressed and is winless since scoring over C&D in July 2024; only fourth of six on stable debut at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago but he was the 7-4 favourite and got upset in the stalls, and may have needed that run; interesting to see if he's again strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Only fourth of six on stable debut but was favourite; interesting to see if backers return

runners.name: Oasis Cover
runners.spotlight: Third on handicap/seasonal debut at Nottingham (5f, good) in May and bounced back from lesser run to finish second at Redcar (6f, good) four weeks ago; got loose and withdrawn at Beverley three days later (5-2 at the time); subsequently sold for 4,200gns; respected on stable debut.
runners.comment: Placed in two of her three handicaps and she's respected on her stable debut

runners.name: Von Trotter
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on his first three starts (6f/5f, AW), the latest at Southwell in May, but he's struggled to get competitive on turf in his four handicaps; needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: Runner-up in first three races (6f/5f, AW) but unable to get competitive in turf handicaps

runners.name: Lady Bouquet
runners.spotlight: In good form in the main this year, twice running well at Pontefract (5f/6f, good) last month before respectable fourth of seven at Hamilton (6f, good to firm) on Thursday; possible player.
runners.comment: In good form in the main this year; respectable run on Thursday; possible player

runners.name: Jack Rabbit Slims
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden who may be better at 5f but he's run some good races this year, including beaten just a nose at Beverley (5f, good to firm) two starts ago, and he might not be far away.
runners.comment: 0-13 and may be better at 5f but he's run some good races this year; might not be far away

runners.name: Hurstwood
runners.spotlight: Four-time course winner whose mark continues to fall and he hasn't been devoid of spark this season; however, this 9yo needs to better what he's shown on his last three starts (the first of them over C&D).
runners.comment: Four-time course winner whose mark has dropped but needs step back in right direction
runners.owner: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing

runners.name: Sergeant Mayer
runners.spotlight: Course winner who is well handicapped on last season's form and is one to watch in the betting; however, he finished down the field on his three starts this spring and needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: One to watch in the betting but finished down the field on his three starts this spring

races.race_name: Juddmonte 'Lead Artist' Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden

runners.name: Speakers Corner
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt; dam Group-placed 8.4f winner (RPR 104), sister to winners Delphi (Australian 1m4f Group 2), Matchless (7f-1m4f Flat and 2m hurdle) and Last Galileo (1m 2yo), out of 6f 2yo Group 3 winner; preferred by Moore and yard has farmed this race in recent years.
runners.comment: Wootton Bassett colt, dam group-placed, yard has fine record in this, preferred by Moore
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Anchor Road
runners.spotlight: Dark Angel colt sent off at 4-1 on debut over 6f here (gd-fm) 22 days ago and found things happening a bit quickly before staying on very nicely into fifth, after meeting traffic problems; wasn't knocked about and looks almost certain to improve for this longer trip.
runners.comment: Eye-catching debut here over 6f, looks almost certain to improve for the step up to 7f

runners.name: Porto Vecchio
runners.spotlight: Frankel colt; brother to winners Homeless Songs (7f/1m inc 2yo/Irish 1,000 Guineas; RPR 122) and Spoken Truth (1m2f; 98), half-brother to winners Reve De Vol (7f 2yo/1m2f Listed; 106) and Time Tells All (1m2f; 85); dam 7f winner (inc Listed; 104); impeccably bred and holds multiple Group 1 entries; interesting debutant.
runners.comment: Frankel brother to high-class Homeless Songs, top pedigree, interesting on debut

runners.name: Drumbeat
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt; 200,000gns foal; half-brother to 1m-1m2f winner Garden Route (RPR 93); dam South African 5f-6f 2yo winner (inc Group 1), half-sister to South African 1m Group 1 winner Silver Mountain; nicely bred and holds Group 1 entries, but looks down the stable's pecking order on rider arrangements.
runners.comment: 200,000gns Wootton Bassett colt, dam South African Group  1 winner, overlooked by Moore
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Fort Dearborn
runners.spotlight: Starspangledbanner colt; E150,000 yearling; dam French 1m 2yo winner (RPR 96), sister to 7f winner Borjina, half-sister to useful 1m4f/12.5f winner Plage De Havre, out of maiden half-sister to 1m 2yo Group 2 winner Rich Legacy; holds Group 1 entry; market can guide.
runners.comment: E150,000 Starspangledbanner colt, dam 1m 2yo winner, market best guide on debut
runners.owner: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit

runners.name: Victory Speech
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt; brother to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Beautify (RPR 107), half-brother to winners Library (7.5f 2yo/1m2f Listed; 109) and Vice President (1m2f; 93); dam 7f 2yo/1m4f Group 3 winner (105); lots to like on paper and Lordan rode The Lion In Winter when he won this maiden in 2023; can't discount.
runners.comment: Wootton Bassett colt, dam 7f 2yo winner, Lordan won this for yard in 2023
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

races.race_name: Hailey Equine Irish EBF Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Rebel Wave
runners.spotlight: New Bay filly ran okay without really threatening in her first two maidens, but big step forward at Limerick on latest (7f, soft) when beaten a head by a 77-rated rival; leading form claims on that run, but has to prove she handles this quicker ground (mixed signals on breeding).
runners.comment: Big step forward at Limerick on soft latest, claims on that, unproven on quick ground

runners.name: Pink Coral
runners.spotlight: Well-bred daughter of Wootton Bassett has so far failed to live up to her pedigree; rated 76 after three runs in maidens at around 1m2f, the best of which was a 7.25l third of 10 at Leopardstown in May (1m2f, good); markedly dropped in trip now; needs more.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly rated 76 after 3 starts, drops in trip, more needed to get head in front
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Nautic Star
runners.spotlight: Promise in all three maidens over 7f; decent third of 20 on handicap debut off a mark of 75 here last month (1m, good), not quite getting home; the drop back to 7f should suit on that evidence, and should be in the mix again returned to maiden company.
runners.comment: Promise in 7f maidens, 1m stretched on h'cap bow latest, rated 75, in the mix again
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: Vishaya
runners.spotlight: Placed in two AW maidens early this year; modest run on turf debut in 1m Naas maiden (good); narrowly denied by in-form rival off 74 on handicap debut at Killarney five days ago; should go well again down in trip and returned to maiden company, once this doesn't come too soon.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied on h'cap debut at Killarney 5 days ago, go well again down in trip

runners.name: Saga Lucia
runners.spotlight: Seventh in barrier trial at Naas last year; promise in a couple of AW maidens over 7f and 1m in the autumn; off since and much more needed on turf debut, but the booking of Oisin Murphy catches the eye (2-5 when riding for this stable in Britain and Ireland); check the market.
runners.comment: Minor promise in AW maidens last autumn, more needed but rider booking a plus

runners.name: Otsana
runners.spotlight: Cotai Glory filly; E105,000 yearling; closely related to US 5f turf winner Rebel With A Clue, half-sister to three winners inc Cosmic Vega (7f/1m inc 2yo/Listed/Australia; RPR 111) and The X O (6f AW; 106); dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 2 winner Danehurst; attractively bred and from respected source; check market.
runners.comment: E105,000 Cotai Glory filly, half-sister to three winners, respected source, check market

runners.name: Stooked
runners.spotlight: Pinatubo filly; unsold E220,000 yearling; half-sister to four winners inc Irish Territory (US 1m turf; RPR 105), Moment Of Silence (7f AW; 99) and Zaragoza (6f; 71); dam Listed-placed 1m2f winner (91), half-sister to 1m2f-1m4f Group 1 winner Ghaiyyath; likely type on paper and in-form yard can ready one.
runners.comment: Pinatubo filly, dam listed placed 1m2f winner, likely type on paper, yard can ready one

runners.name: Caislean Ni Cuan
runners.spotlight: Promising start in 7f maiden at Leopardstown in May, beaten 3.25l into fourth of nine despite racing a shade keenly; off since and that form hasn't really worked out, but she's open to improvement and could go well if settling better.
runners.comment: Keen on debut at Leopardstown, open to improvement, could go well if settles better

runners.name: Wooloongabba
runners.spotlight: 150-1 and failed to beat a rival on debut at Navan; seems safe to rule out.
runners.comment: 150-1 and last to finish on debut at Navan, seems safe to rule out

runners.name: Lilli's Angel
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and never got involved on debut over 6f here (gd-fm) last month when sent off at 28-1; a bit of stamina in pedigree so worth a go at this longer trip, but lots more needed.
runners.comment: Slowly away and never involved over 6f here on debut, lots more needed up in trip

runners.name: Kidd
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and soundly beaten in maidens at Bellewstown (5f, good) and Navan (6f, good); major improvement needed upped further in trip.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten at huge odds in maidens at Bellewstown and Navan, much more needed

runners.name: Never The Same
runners.spotlight: E330,000 No Nay Never filly was sent off at 12-1 on debut at Dundalk (6f) last November and finished in mid-field; off since and looks the stable's second string here on rider arrangements.
runners.comment: 12-1 and midfield on Dundalk debut in Nov', off since, overlooked by McMonagle
runners.owner: Philip Antonacci & Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs John Magnier

races.race_name: Al Shira'aa Racing Meadow Court Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: One Look
runners.spotlight: Five wins from 16 starts, the most recent coming in this race a year ago; fine efforts in defeat in both starts this term, in a Group 2 here over 1m and when beaten 1.5l into second behind the talented Estrange in the Pretty Polly last time over C&D (gd-fm); may prove hard to beat with a repeat of that.
runners.comment: Five wins include this race last year, superb effort in Gr' 1 here latest, the one to beat

runners.name: Rhapsody
runners.spotlight: British raider is 2-6, her wins coming last season in a Yarmouth novice and a class 4 handicap at York off 83; signed off with a Listed third in Italy and ran a blinder on her seasonal return in the Kensington Palace Handicap at Royal Ascot when not getting the clearest of runs; her official rating of 92 may underestimate her and she could outrun her likely odds.
runners.comment: A shade unlucky in Royal Ascot handicap latest, rating of 92 may underestimate her

runners.name: Nyra
runners.spotlight: German recruit is 1-11 but has run some cracking races in defeat; respectable Listed run here over 1m4f (good) on first run for this stable; even better when just 0.5l behind Oaks contender Sparan Nua in 1m4f Cork Group 3 (good) on latest, when conceding lots of weight; non-runner on account of good to firm ground here last month, however, and similar conditions likely again.
runners.comment: 1-11 but some big runs in defeat, close second to Sparan Nua latest, fast ground a query

runners.name: Dreamasar
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced British challenger is a three-time winner; 2-4 on turf, the wins coming off 81 in a Salisbury handicap in May (1m2f, gd-fm) and a Listed race at Haydock later that month (10.5f, gd-sft); 3.75l fourth of seven in a Group 3 on the AW at Newcastle last time; place claims.
runners.comment: 2-4 on turf, 3.75l fourth in Newcastle Group 3 on latest, place claims here
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Racing 2 & J Fill

runners.name: Francophone
