runners.spotlight: British raider is talented on her day; two-time winner at Listed level, but has come up well short in a trio of Group 2s this season, most recently when beaten 12.5l in the Duke Of Cambridge at Royal Ascot (1m, gd-fm); needs a revival stepped back up in trip.
runners.comment: Two-time Listed winner, below best in 1m Group 2s this season, needs a revival up in trip

runners.name: Moody
runners.spotlight: One of two for last year's winning yard; won on her second start for Andre Fabre last year; bought for E125,000 in December and has won back-to-back Listed races on her first two starts for Paddy Twomey, over 1m4f at Cork (sft-hvy) and 1m6f at Gowran (gd-yld); up in class  and drops back in trip; might prefer a bit of an ease in the ground.
runners.comment: Back-to-back Listed wins at 1m4f/1m6f, moves up in class, may prefer easier ground

runners.name: Subsonic
runners.spotlight: C&D maiden winner on yielding to soft last September; good third on seasonal return in Listed heat at Gowran (9.5f, good to yielding) but soundly beaten in another Listed race at Naas on latest (1m1f, good); moves up in grade and trip; new headgear combination needs to eke out more.
runners.comment: C&D winner, good Listed run on seasonal return, not as good latest, new headgear combo

runners.name: Spicy Margarita
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a 3yo Dundalk maiden early last year; 0-10 in stakes races and yet to trouble the judge, though was only 1.75l behind the winner in a 1m Listed race here on latest (good); more needed upped in trip and grade.
runners.comment: 0-10 in stakes company, not beaten far in Listed latest, needs more up in trip/grade
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

races.race_name: Liverpool FC Foundation Scurry Handicap

runners.name: Red Evolution
runners.spotlight: Won twice last year over 5f at Cork and also finished second to Keke here in the Rockingham, a fine effort for a horse of his age; not at his best at Dundalk on first start this year; down the field behind Genesis in the Rockingham last month.
runners.comment: Second to Keke in last year's Rockingham, down the field behind Genesis in 2026 edition

runners.name: Gavoo
runners.spotlight: Two wins last season, a Listowel maiden and a 6f Dundalk event; beaten by the odds-on Oro Blanco in a two-horse race last time; previously unplaced favourite in a 7f handicap here.
runners.comment: Beaten in a two-horse race last time, previously unplaced favourite in a 7f handicap here

runners.name: Go Athletico
runners.spotlight: Nine-time turf winner, including a 6f Group 3 at this venue in 2023, Listed contests and this event 12 months ago; was once rated 108, so has dropped a long way; inconsistent this year; good run when second here last time, 3lb wrong
runners.comment: Smart at his peak, won this last year, inconsistent this year, second last time, 3lb wrong

runners.name: Dark Ace
runners.spotlight: Has become highly dependable since being gelded, winning three of his last eight starts, including two on AW in Britain; leading contender after Rockingham third with several of these rivals behind him; overall form favours him over the winner Genesis.
runners.comment: Has become highly dependable since being gelded, leading contender after Rockingham third
runners.owner: J Fairhurst & Damian McCann & Cyril McMullan

runners.name: Back Down Under
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come at this track but over 6f/7f; this season's form linked to Genesis and Headmaster puts her in the mix, although several others would seem to have marginally stronger claims.
runners.comment: Has a fair record at this track, form linked to Genesis and Headmaster puts her in the mix

runners.name: Moltophino
runners.spotlight: Runner-up six times before belatedly opening his account in a premier handicap over 6f here; fifth in this race last year; two satisfactory runs this term; could go well, but a record of one win from 22 starts makes it hard to be overly confident.
runners.comment: Only one win from 23 starts, fifth in this race last year, two satisfactory runs this term

runners.name: Genesis
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner who got off the mark on turf in a 6f handicap here in May; badly hampered in the race won by Headmaster later that month; 3lb wrong when taking the 5f Rockingham Handicap here last time; stiff task off his new rating,
runners.comment: 3lb wrong when taking a major 5f handicap here last month, stiff task off his new rating

runners.name: Oro Blanco
runners.spotlight: Stable second-string when landing a 7f maiden at Fairyhouse on his third start; added to his score by beating Gavoo in a two-horse race at Naas; still relatively unexposed.
runners.comment: Added to his 7f Fairyhouse maiden win by beating Gavoo in a two-horse race, progressive

runners.name: Sondad
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Ayr Silver Cup (6f, soft) last September when first home on his side; repeated a 2025 Epsom win (6f, soft) early last month; first of his small group when ninth in the Wokingham; generally dependable sort; stable won this in 2016.
runners.comment: Generally dependable sprinter, first of his small group when ninth in the Wokingham

runners.name: Alfred Tennyson
runners.spotlight: 7f maiden winner at Limerick last season on his sixth and final start for Aidan O'Brien; went close in a 6f handicap at Navan three starts ago; 4lb wrong, up against it.
runners.comment: Former Aidan O'Brien-trained 7f maiden winner, uneven form this season, 4lb wrong

runners.name: Bodhi Bear
runners.spotlight: Two handicap wins this season, over 5f here (sft-hvy) and over the same trip at Navan on (good); virtually inseparable from Tango Flare based on Listed third behind course specialist here last time; both could feature.
runners.comment: Same chance as Tango Flare based on Listed third here last time, both could feature

runners.name: The Highway Rat
runners.spotlight: Best known for AW exploits, also effective on turf; second to Bodhi Bear in a 5f handicap at Navan; visor now replaces blinkers following a below-par Dundalk run last Sunday.
runners.comment: Best known for AW exploits, also effective on turf, second to Bodhi Bear at Navan

runners.name: Sir Les Patterson
runners.spotlight: All five wins have come on the AW, including two at 6f last winter; highlight of turf form when third to Tango Flare here last autumn; fair form this term, but needs first-time cheekpieces to have an improving effect.
runners.comment: All five wins on AW, highlight of turf form when third to Tango Flare here last autumn

runners.name: Glory To Be
runners.spotlight: Both wins this season have been gained over 7f; asserted late in a seven-runner contest at Fairyhouse ten days ago; may find some of these rivals too speedy.
runners.comment: Both wins this season have been gained over 7f, may find some of these rivals too speedy

runners.name: City House
runners.spotlight: Smart turf form at up to 7f in Bahrain for George Scott early last year; some good runs this year, second to Sir Les Patterson on the AW (6f) in February and close fourth at Chester in May (7.5f, good); no luck in running in the Habitat here (won by Headmaster), again behind that rival at Cork.
runners.comment: No luck in running in the Habitat (won by Headmaster), again behind that rival at Cork

runners.name: Headmaster
runners.spotlight: Added to two British 7f wins when bagging the Habitat Handicap (6f, good) here in May on second start for new yard; had difficulty finding a gap before storming home to win by a neck with several of these behind; another solid display over 7f at Cork; top trainer of sprinters won this in 2020 and 2021.
runners.comment: Fine 7f display after overcoming trouble to win over the orthodox 6f here, strong chance

runners.name: Tango Flare
runners.spotlight: Beat course specialist Big Gossey when winning the Bold Lad Handicap here last September; no luck in running in two handicaps this term; won a Fairyhouse conditions race for the third time in four years before a fine second to Big Gossey in a Listed race here last time, a whisker in front of Bodhi Bear.
runners.comment: No luck in running in two handicaps this term, fine second in a Listed race here last time

runners.name: Cuban Grey
runners.spotlight: Admirable sort with seven wins and 17 places to his name; struggled in two turf starts in the first half of last month following a Dundalk win; outran his 33-1 odds when fourth behind Genesis here on latest.
runners.comment: 5f winner on AW in May, outran his 33-1 odds when fourth behind Genesis here last month

runners.name: Keke
runners.spotlight: Has recorded six of his eight wins over 5f, including last year's Rockingham Handicap here; proved that he is in good shape with a conditions race victory at Naas a fortnight ago; has run well in Listed events this term; trainer has a strong contender in Headmaster.
runners.comment: Eight wins, probably best over 5f (won last year's Rockingham here), in good shape lately

runners.name: Dark Thirty
runners.spotlight: Ex-Richard Hannon; off the mark for the Quinn team when making virtually all in a 22-runner handicap at York Dante meeting (6f, good); bounced straight back from a lesser run at Thirsk when second at Ripon; made all for a 6f Chester win three weeks ago; stable won this with Mr Wagyu in 2022.
runners.comment: In good form since joining the Quinns, ground and trip close to optimum, merits respect

runners.name: Leveraging
runners.spotlight: Lacks an outing this year and is 6lb out of the handicap; signed off last year with 6f AW maiden win; gelded since; rider's claim the main plus.
runners.comment: Lacks an outing this year and is 6lb out of the handicap, rider's claim the main plus

races.race_name: Tulfarris Hotel And Golf Resort Sapphire Stakes (Group 2)

runners.name: Rosy Affair
runners.spotlight: Consistent British raider boasts a decent strike rate of 5-13 but her last four wins have come over 6f; finished a 1.5l fourth (a nose ahead of Jakajaro) over 5f in the King Charles III at Royal Ascot last time and there shouldn't be much between them again here; big player.
runners.comment: British mare, excellent fourth at Ascot latest, closely matched with Jakajaro, big player

runners.name: Havana Anna
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly is 3-9 with all three of her wins coming over 5f/6f at Naas; won a Group 3 over the latter trip on her seasonal return (good) and outran her odds of 28-1 when a fine 2l fourth in the Commonwealth Cup (6f, gd-fm); gets all the allowances here and the drop back to 5f should pose no problems; big chance.
runners.comment: Fine fourth at Royal Ascot (6f) latest, gets all the allowances, drops in trip, big chance

runners.name: Jakajaro
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer started his campaign with back-to-back handicap wins at Newmarket (5f, good) and York (5f, good); yet to score at Pattern level but huge runs the last twice in the Group 2 Temple Stakes at Haydock (5f, good) and when a 1.5l fifth of 26 in the King Charles III (5f, gd-fm) at Royal Ascot; fourth in this last year and should be in the mix again.
runners.comment: Huge run in the King Charles III latest, fourth in this last year, in the mix again

runners.name: Charles Darwin
runners.spotlight: 3yo won three of his four starts last season, including the Norfolk Stakes (5f, gd-fm); started off this campaign with a Listed win at Naas (6f, gd-yld) but has questions to answer after finishing well beaten in a Group 3 back at Naas and in the Commonwealth Cup in first-time blinkers (retained) on latest; the pick of Moore, but needs to get back on track down in trip.
runners.comment: Royal Ascot winner at two, 6f Listed win on return, poor last twice, preferred by Moore

runners.name: Cover Up
runners.spotlight: British raider was in fine form at Meydan at the turn of the year, winning a Listed (yielding) and a Group 2 (good), both over 5f; didn't get the smoothest of runs when beaten 3.5l in the King Charles III at Royal Ascot last time (behind Rosy Affair and Jakajaro) and could get closer here if getting a clear passage.
runners.comment: Traffic problems when not beaten that far in the King Charles III, could get closer now

runners.name: Bucanero Fuerte
runners.spotlight: Classy juvenile and a six-time winner, including four times at this track over 5f/6f; two wins last season included a Listed heat over 5f at Naas and the Group 3 Phoenix Sprint Stakes here over 6f (both on good); weakened late over 6f in a Group 2 here last time, and not dismissed back at 5f.
runners.comment: Four course wins, weakened late over 6f here on latest, could go well down in trip
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Ipanema Queen
runners.spotlight: Speedy two-time Listed winner (including over C&D); yet to win this season; beaten off 95 in a handicap over C&D in June and again off 1lb lower in the Palace Of Holyrood at Royal Ascot on latest; much more needed upped in grade.
runners.comment: Two-time Listed winner, beaten off marks in mid-90s in handicaps last twice, needs more
runners.owner: Stonestreet Stables, LLC & AMO Racing Limited

runners.name: Brussels
runners.spotlight: 3yo son of Wootton Bassett signed off last term with an excellent second at the Breeders' Cup (5f, firm) but form has been regressive this season, albeit all three runs have come over 6f; the drop back to 5f is a positive, but he has a fair bit to find on the figures and Ryan Moore prefers the chances of Charles Darwin.
runners.comment: Regressive form this season over 6f; drop back to 5f a plus, but overlooked by Moore

runners.name: Kendall Roy
runners.spotlight: Six-time handicap winner (including over C&D); took his form to a new level when winning a Listed heat at Cork (5f, good) last month when wearing this headgear combination for the first time; this is much harder, so another step forward is required.
runners.comment: Took form to new level with Listed win at Cork, this harder, another step forward needed
runners.owner: Miss Kate McGivern & Thomas Hore & Shane M Power

runners.name: Partisan Hero
runners.spotlight: British challenger a five-time handicap winner, most recently scoring off 92 at York in May;  creditable first run in stakes company in a Sandown Group 3 last time when a 1.25l third behind the 110-rated Rumstar; that's solid form and Colin Keane keeps the faith; place chance.
runners.comment: Very creditable effort in Group 3 at Sandown latest, Keane keeps faith, place chance

races.race_name: GAIN Railway Stakes (Group 2)

runners.name: Confucius
runners.spotlight: Just denied over 5f here on soft first time out; won with plenty to spare over 6f at Naas; ran respectably, but well below general expectations, when sixth behind stablemate Great Barrier Reef in the Coventry Stakes; needs to redeem himself after odds-on Group 3 defeat behind two De Aguiar-trained runners here three weeks ago; needs to settle better; Moore sticks with him.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite in the Coventry, needs to redeem himself after odds-on Group 2 defeat

runners.name: Carry The Flag
runners.spotlight: Not especially convincing when landing the odds over 5f at Naas on second start; much sharper next time over C&D when second to the subsequent Coventry winner Great Barrier Reef; beaten 7l into ninth after going off 5-2 favourite in the Norfolk; got up late to win a 5f Listed race at Naas a fortnight ago; cheekpieces on now.
runners.comment: Made amends for Norfolk Stakes failure with 5f Listed win at Naas, Group 3-placed over C&D

runners.name: Immortal Guard
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden on debut before a fine effort in the Group 3 Marble Hill Stakes; third behind the subsequent Coventry winner Great Barrier Reef then, 1 1/4l off Carry The Flag; second to a longer-priced stablemate in Group 3 Anglesey Stakes here three weeks ago, a head in front of the odds-on Confucius.
runners.comment: One place behind Carry The Flag over C&D, a head in front of Confucius in  Anglesey Stakes
runners.owner: Ramiro Restrepo & Jacob West & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Celeron
runners.spotlight: Refused to enter the stalls on his intended debut at Navan; made a good impression over C&D early last month; missed the break in the Windsor Castle; will need to be a lot sharper.
runners.comment: Missed the break in the Windsor Castle, made a good impression over C&D early last month

runners.name: Switching Sides
runners.spotlight: Promising debut behind a Ballydoyle-trained colt over C&D; still looked raw when winning narrowly at Fairyhouse; will need to be a lot more streetwise here.
runners.comment: Promising debut over C&D, still looked raw when winning narrowly at Fairyhouse, big task

runners.name: The Scallionator
runners.spotlight: Listowel maiden winner on his third outing; out of his depth in the Coventry; 90-rated colt will need others to underperform.
runners.comment: Listowel maiden winner, out of his depth in the Coventry, will need others to underperform

runners.name: Tribeca
runners.spotlight: Form of debut win at Navan has worked out; finished behind Carry The Flag in the Norfolk; Robson De Aguiar also saddles Immortal Guard, who was involved in the stable's Group 3 one-two here last month.
runners.comment: Form of debut win at Navan has worked out, finished behind Carry The Flag in the Norfolk
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Mrs A O'Callaghan

races.race_name: Juddmonte Irish Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies)

runners.name: Thundering On
runners.spotlight: Group 3-placed on second start at two; beaten favourite in a maiden on seasonal debut before a comfortable win in a Group 3 at Navan (1m2f, good to yielding) in April; confidently ridden before taking full command in the final furlong in the Oaks; excuses for her eclipse in Pretty Polly, coughed and probably not suited by quick ground/shorter trip; ideal trip here, going the worry.
runners.comment: Oaks heroine, coughed after Pretty Polly defeat, ideal trip here, quick ground the concern

runners.name: Earth Shot
runners.spotlight: 5l win at Newmarket (1m2f, good) in May on second start and then went very close against Inis Mor in a Listed race at Goodwood (1m2f, good); appreciated the step up in trip when gaining a narrow win from Johanna Walsh in the Ribblesdale; highly likely to be involved in the finish.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Inis Mor and Johanna Walsh, open to further progress, strong chance

runners.name: Inis Mor
runners.spotlight: Two 7f Newmarket wins and a fine second in France as a juvenile; fourth in the Nell Gwyn and failed to feature in the 1,000 Guineas; found her vocation when upped to 1m2f at Goodwood, getting the better of Earth Shot; enhanced her reputation with fine third behind  Diamond Necklace in the Prix de Diane; Earth Shot may have her measure at this trip.
runners.comment: Fine third in the Prix de Diane, may struggle to uphold 1m2f Goodwood form with Earth Shot

runners.name: Amelia Earhart
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden at Leopardstown (1m, yielding) last October on her fifth start; reappeared with 2l win in the Cheshire Oaks at Chester (11.3f, good) in first-time hood and blinkers; failed to handle the track when favourite for the Oaks; change of headgear, Moore stays loyal; pick of a Ballydoyle quintet.
runners.comment: Failed to handle the track when favourite at Epsom, change of headgear, Moore stays loyal
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Sparan Nua
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten filly; won a Naas maiden at 25-1 on debut (1m, good) and confirmed ability when showing a good turn of foot in a slowly-run Gowran conditions race (9.5f good to yielding); deserves to take her chance after a Group 3 win over this trip at Cork.
runners.comment: Unbeaten filly, deserves to take her chance after a Group 3 win over this trip at Cork

runners.name: Johanna Walsh
runners.spotlight: Won at the third attempt, making all in a maiden at Leopardstown (1m2f, good) in May; took the sharp rise in class in her stride when going very close against Earth Shot in the Ribblesdale; further improvement on the cards; helps to give Joseph O'Brien a strong hand.
runners.comment: Just denied by Earth Shot in the Ribblesdale, helps to give Joseph O'Brien a strong hand

runners.name: Rebel Moon
runners.spotlight: Debut winner on soft in a maiden at Gowran in March, relegating stablemate Johanna Walsh to third; coped well with good ground and a furlong further when landing a Group 3 at Naas; now takes on her Oaks-winning stable's Thundering On and the much-improved Johanna Walsh.
runners.comment: Unbeaten in two races, the opposition includes two more experienced stablemates

runners.name: Cameo
runners.spotlight: Course 7f maiden winner at two (soft to heavy); took a big step forward to win in the Listed Oaks Trial at Lingfield (good to firm) on her sixth start, and her first run beyond 1m; appeared to have a good chance of staying the Oaks trip, but faded from over two furlongs down; limitations evident at Naas.
runners.comment: Oaks Trial winner at Lingfield, faded tamely at Epsom, limitations evident at Naas
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Sugar Island
runners.spotlight: Third in Group 2 May Hill at Doncaster last September and readily made all in Group 3 here in October; fourth of five behind Amelia Earhart at Chester on reappearance, reversed form with her disappointing stablemate when third at Epsom, weakened late, beaten almost 10l; first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Fourth of five behind Amelia Earhart at Chester, reversed that form when third at Epsom
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Beautify
runners.spotlight: Group 2 winner over 6f at this venue last summer and close second to Precise in the Moyglare; well beaten in the Cheveley Park, and down the field in the Nell Gwyn on seasonal debut; sixth of 11 in the Irish 1,000 Guineas; unconvincing run in the 1m2f Pretty Polly; unappealing on first attempt at 1m4f.
runners.comment: Has failed to build on last year's Moyglare second, unappealing on first attempt at 1m4f
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Composing
runners.spotlight: Dual Pattern winner in busy 2025 campaign; has raced six times to much less effect since her 7f Group 2 success here last August; sole runner for Ballydoyle in the Ribblesdale, hampered and hung right; not a bad effort, but well held by Earth Shot and Johanna Walsh.
runners.comment: Dual Pattern winner in busy 2025 campaign, around 5l behind Earth Shot at Royal Ascot

races.race_name: Hill Of Allen Stud Handicap

runners.name: Trustmore
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in all three maidens but has shown ability; stayed on well over 1m at Leopardstown in May; well behind Noble Honour and Tanzanite Diamond at Fairyhouse upped to 1m2f (good) on latest; gelded since and blinkers go on for handicap debut; could improve, but others have stronger form claims.
runners.comment: Unplaced in maidens but has ability, gelded, blinkers on, may improve but others preferred

runners.name: Genchev
runners.spotlight: Failed to win at two, but got off the mark on second start of this season in 1m2f (yielding) maiden at Navan; never landed a blow on handicap debut in the King George V handicap at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) last time; capable of better, but has to prove he handles quick ground.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on handicap debut at Ascot, capable of better, fast ground a query
runners.owner: David Spratt & Sean Jones & Mrs Lynne Lyons

runners.name: Yousaynothingatall
runners.spotlight: Cork maiden winner in May (1m2f, soft); beaten off 78 in handicap on her previous start (also at Cork) over 1m4f (gd-yld) and is 5lb higher now; remote third in 1m4f (soft) Listed race at Leopardstown on latest; drop back in trip a plus and probably capable of better.
runners.comment: Cork maiden winner in May, well held in Listed race latest, capable of better down in trip

runners.name: Tanzanite Diamond
runners.spotlight: Fairly modest form in four maidens; behind Noble Honour at Fairyhouse on penultimate over 1m2f (good); beaten 13l when fourth of 17 over 1m4f (good) back there on latest; tongue tie and cheekpieces go on for handicap debut; probably best watched.
runners.comment: Fairly modest form in maidens, tongue tie and cheekpieces on for handicap bow, watch

runners.name: Noble Honour
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutante; placed in all three maiden starts at 1m-10.5f on varying ground; found just one too good at Fairyhouse on latest (1m2f, good) where she had Tanzanite Diamond 5.5l behind; bred to be better than her opening mark of 78 and interesting runner for yard that won this last year and in 2021.
runners.comment: Handicap debutante, placed in all three maidens, yard won this last year, interesting

runners.name: Vanir
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutante; shed the maiden tag at the third attempt over 1m4f at Fairyhouse (good) 17 days ago; opening mark doesn't look overly generous and it's debatable whether this drop back in trip will suit, but unexposed and can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Handiap debutante, 1m4f maiden win latest, drops in trip, unexposed, not discounted

races.race_name: WTW Willis Handicap

runners.name: Namiid
runners.spotlight: Failed to win at two; put that right when making all in a Navan maiden (5f, yielding) in first-time cheekpieces; not beaten far on handicap debut at the same venue in blinkers (5f, good); another good run in cheekpieces (retained) at Bellewstown; big burden, rider's claim will help.
runners.comment: Maiden winner over this trip, fair handicap form, big burden, rider's claim will help

runners.name: Focaccia
runners.spotlight: In rear in a C&D handicap last month; on the upgrade now judged on the evidence of a front-running maiden win at Bellewstown; raised 7lb.
runners.comment: In rear in a C&D handicap last month, front-running maiden winner at Bellewstown, up 7lb

runners.name: Real Encounter
runners.spotlight: Narrowly beaten in a 6f Dundalk maiden in April before winning over 5f there 13 days later; definite merit in handicap debut at Naas, close up until reportedly hitting a ridge over a furlong down, before rallying; went close in a C&D handicap before a solid third over 6f on latest; likely to make her presence felt.
runners.comment: 5f AW maiden winner, went close in a C&D handicap before a solid third over 6f on latest

runners.name: Nouvel Espoir
runners.spotlight: Gained fourth win of his career at Down Royal (5f, soft) last month; solid overall form this season; close fourth behind Sovereign Cry at Naas two weeks ago, form boosted by the third when scoring at Leopardstown on Thursday.
runners.comment: Solid overall form this season, won on soft last month, also handles quick ground
runners.owner: Ms Yvonne Hennessy & Ms S O'Neill

runners.name: Final Melody
runners.spotlight: Finished off last year in fine form at Dundalk, backing up a nursery win with a short-head second in a conditions race; had previously finished second in two turf nurseries; was entitled to need last Sunday's Dundalk run when 4lb out of the handicap and slowly away; could be a different proposition now
runners.comment: Was entitled to need last Sunday's run, speedy filly, consistent in nurseries last season
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & Kevin Osborne & N W T Dalzell & Tracey Wylie

runners.name: Gonna Be Golden
runners.spotlight: Won fillies' maiden at Dundalk last December; fair third at Down Royal on her sole 5f attempt; outstayed over 7f at Dundalk last Sunday.
runners.comment: Outstayed over 7f at Dundalk last Sunday, fair third at Down Royal on her sole 5f attempt

runners.name: Happy Henry
runners.spotlight: Belatedly off the mark at Navan last month in first-time cheekpieces; another good run at Naas (third of 21); underlined his rate of improvement when winning again at Bellewstown; up an aggregate 17lb.
runners.comment: Consistent sort, took a long time to win a race, has now won two of his last three

runners.name: Carrigans Grove
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a successful 2025, winning three sprint handicaps; yet to hit form this term; some sign of a revival in a 7f event at Fairyhouse ten days ago.
runners.comment: Enjoyed a successful 2025, winning three sprint handicaps, yet to hit top form this term

runners.name: Tawaazon
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner, including five on turf; last won over 6f (good) here in May 2025; went close in a 21-runner 5f handicap at Naas three starts ago; faded late into fifth behind Sovereign Cry when favourite back at Naas last time.
runners.comment: Over a year since the most recent of his nine wins, faded late when favourite on latest

runners.name: Mary Shoelaces
runners.spotlight: Two of her three wins have come over C&D, including this race in 2024 off a mark of 60 (now 6lb higher); limited appeal on recent form, but could surprise.
runners.comment: Two of her three wins have come over C&D, limited appeal on recent form, could surprise

runners.name: Imperial Dream
runners.spotlight: Most recent of three wins came here nearly two years ago (6f, good-to-firm); has never run over this trip; hard to make a case for him.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in two races this term, has never run over this trip, hard to make a case

runners.name: Absoluteassignment
runners.spotlight: Showed hints of ability in three maidens at 7f; second over 6f at Fairyhouse on handicap debut; not as good at the same venue last time; may find 5f too sharp.
runners.comment: Second over 6f on handicap debut, not as good last time, may find 5f too sharp

runners.name: Sovereign Cry
runners.spotlight: 5f Dundalk winner last season; stepped up on previous turf form when winning at Naas; more on his plate now; worth noting form was boosted by the third when scoring at Leopardstown on Thursday.
runners.comment: 5f AW winner, stepped up on previous turf form when winning at Naas, more on his plate now
runners.owner: John B O'Hagan & Mrs John Murphy

runners.name: Nebrook Star
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in Britain at two; will need to have improved to feature here on debut for this stable.
runners.comment: Showed some promise in Britain at two, will need to have improved to feature here

runners.name: Daneh Of Dandy
runners.spotlight: Won two of her first three races at two in Britain; made low-key Irish debut at Down Royal; hard to be confident, but no surprise if she is competitive.
runners.comment: Won two of her first three races at two in Britain, made low-key Irish debut at Down Royal

runners.name: Lamar Canyon
runners.spotlight: First run after being gelded when showing much-improved form to beat Foccacia in a 5f AW maiden in May; outpaced at Cork in his first handicap
runners.comment: Beat Foccacia in a 5f AW maiden in May, outpaced at Cork in his first handicap

runners.name: Apache Outlaw
runners.spotlight: Solid form in four runs on turf since an unproductive spell on AW; needs to find extra on the evidence of last Saturday's third at Limerick; previous third at this venue was over 7f.
runners.comment: Solid form in four runs on turf since an unproductive spell on AW, needs to find extra

runners.name: Harry's Hill
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner, including twice over C&D; no joy yet this season; ran better than the bare result from 10lb out of the handicap in the Rockingham; finished well in the recent Naas event won by Sovereign Cry; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Finished well in the recent Naas event won by Sovereign Cry, fair C&D run before that

races.race_name: EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: China In Your Hand
runners.spotlight: 11-1 for Doncaster debut (7f, good to firm) one month ago, where she raced freely and had to be switched under 2f out but put in some sterling late work into third of 13 to a more experienced winner; should have plenty to offer this time.
runners.comment: 11-1 for 7f debut at Doncaster when good late work into 3rd; should have plenty to offer
runners.owner: C Wright Mrs C Corbett G Hargreave

runners.name: Caravel
runners.spotlight: Easy to back for Doncaster debut (7f, good to firm; 22-1) in June where she faded in the closing stages and was beaten nearly 6l; has more than 4l to make up on the stronger-finishing third China In Your Hand and, although there's improvement to come, a turnaround looks unlikely.
runners.comment: 22-1, faded into 7th on Doncaster debut over 7f, over 4l behind China In Your Hand

runners.name: Necromancer
runners.spotlight: First foal; by Bangkok out of bumper, 2m hurdle and 1m4f AW (RPR 82) winner from just four starts, half-sister to winners Tabjeel (1m2f AW), Zaaneh (7f/8.6f) and Bairam (6f 2yo); first impressions suggest longer trips may be needed but the betting should be helpful; leading yard won this in 2024.
runners.comment: May need further but market helpful for leading yard that won this in 2024

runners.name: Lunar Blossom
runners.spotlight: 23,000euros yearling; eleventh foal; Space Traveller half-sister to seven winners including Leshlaa (7f-1m2f including 2yo/Turkish Listed; RPR 114) and Mulzamm (7f-8.5f including 2yo/AW; 106); dam 1m2f AW winner (82); trainer has a useful strike-rate with the few 2yos he's run this year, including with newcomers; check the betting.
runners.comment: 23,000euros yearling; trainer has useful record with 2yos this year, including on debut

runners.name: Indian Lights
runners.spotlight: 47,000gns yearling; by Sioux Nation; seventh foal; closely related to US 5f/5.5f turf 2yo winner Amanzi Yimpilo (including stakes), half-sister to 7f winner Rain Or Shine (AW; 60); yard's sole 2yo turf winner this year (out of 31) had had a run and others make more paper appeal.
runners.comment: 47,000gns yearling; yard 1-31 with 2yos on turf this year; others make more appeal

runners.name: Flooding
runners.spotlight: 58,000euros yearling; second foal; Ghaiyyath half-sister to Group-placed 6f/7f winner Royalty Bay (including 2yo; RPR 94); dam 7f/1m AW winner (73), half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Go Bears Go; likely type on pedigree and market can guide.
runners.comment: 58,000euros yearling; useful pedigree for the trip and market can guide

runners.name: Angel Of Heaven
runners.spotlight: Smart pedigree and she was sent off favourite for her 7f debut on Kempton AW 19 days ago, only to finish well adrift; may have had a hidden excuse and interesting to see if her supporters come back for more.
runners.comment: Smart pedigree but soundly beaten favourite for 7f AW debut; may have had an excuse

runners.name: Pertinent
runners.spotlight: Big prices and not yet achieved much, in 5f and 7f maidens at Leicester.
runners.comment: Big prices and not yet achieved much, in 5f and 7f maidens at Leicester

runners.name: Potters Margot
runners.spotlight: 9-1 for 6f debut on Lingfield AW in June, when showing some mid-race promise before dropping out; may be more of a handicap prospect.
runners.comment: 9-1 for 6f AW debut when showng some mid-race promise; likely more of a handicap prospect

runners.name: Kiah
runners.spotlight: Bred with stamina in mind on both sides of her pedigree so no surprise she never showed on her 6f debut at Newbury (50-1) 16 days ago; the extra furlong is likely to suit but probably not enough.
runners.comment: Never showed on 6f debut (50-1); extra furlong will help but likely to need further

races.race_name: Ric And Mary Hambro Aphrodite Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Orionis
runners.spotlight: Posted her first triple-digit RPR when landing 1m4f Goodwood handicap (good) on seasonal return; the form of that race was boosted by the runner-up winning a Listed race next time but she couldn't uphold it herself when behind a few of these in Pontefract Listed event four weeks ago, although the way she weakened quickly late on suggests something may not have been right.
runners.comment: Form of handicap win on return solid but behind a few of these in Pontefract Listed since

runners.name: Revoir
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-9 since debut win but her Listed record reads 252222, going down by only a neck at Pontefract (1m4f, good; three of today's rivals behind) most recently; due a change of luck.
runners.comment: Second at Listed level for fifth time when beaten neck at Pontefract latest; key player

runners.name: K Sarra
runners.spotlight: Sister to connections' Dante/Voltiguer winner Pride Of Arras; comfortable win at Southwell (1m, AW) last November on sole 2yo start; found the drop to 7f against her in Fred Darling on reappearance and left that well behind when third to Legacy Link in the Musidora at York (extended 1m2f, good) in May; never involved in the Oaks at Epsom since but retains potential with her sights lowered.
runners.comment: Third in Musidora; the Oaks was a step too far since but retains potential down in class

runners.name: Naga
runners.spotlight: Progressed into a useful handicapper since last autumn; couldn't cope with a steep rise in class when 9l fourth in 1m3f Carlisle Group 3 (good to firm) seven weeks ago but it was a good race for the grade (won by Estrange) and the way she stuck on suggests 1m4f should be within range even though she's a bit of a keen goer.
runners.comment: Largely progressive; not disgraced in strong Group 3 latest and this a bit easier

runners.name: Little Dorrit
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who made a creditable return to action when 4l fifth (Revoir 3.75l ahead in second) in 1m4f Pontefract Listed event (good) four weeks ago, staying on after getting outpaced; entitled to come on for the run.
runners.comment: Low-mileage sort who was behind Revoir on Pontefract return but may come on for the run

runners.name: Tribal Queen
runners.spotlight: Got the hang of things late when just under 3l behind Fashion's Fancy on her 1m2f Haydock debut and made all with ease at Kempton (1m3f) 19 days later; has a similar profile to her half-sister, Spirited Style, who won this race last year on her third start.
runners.comment: Her half-sister won this last year and she looked useful when bolting up on AW last time

runners.name: Fashion's Fancy
runners.spotlight: Confirmed debut promise when landing short odds in novice at Haydock (1m2f, soft) eight weeks ago, with reopposing stablemate Tribal Queen (won next time) just under 3l back in third; this is a jump in class but the Haydock form has also been boosted by the runner-up and her leading stable has won this with a lightly raced 3yo twice in recent years; hooded first time; interesting.
runners.comment: Form of Haydock novice win in May boosted and yard does well in this; hooded

runners.name: Brielle
runners.spotlight: Returned with a win in 1m4f Thirsk handicap (good; first-time tongue-tie) in May; creditable effort when sixth of nine in a Listed race at Pontefract (1m4f, good again) since but the reopposing Revoir was 4.5l ahead in second; improvement needed at this level.
runners.comment: 4.5l behind Revoir when fifth at Pontefract latest and needs improvement at this level

runners.name: Club Class
runners.spotlight: Has developed into quite a useful handicapper on AW but will need to raise her game considerably back on turf if she's to play a leading role in this company.
runners.comment: Quite a useful handicapper on AW but needs to raise game considerably here

races.race_name: Lettergold Plastics Handicap

runners.name: Where's Freddy
runners.spotlight: All three wins on turf have been achieved on this course (7f/1m); beaten around 9l in two comeback outings in recent months but eased 3lb and capable of bouncing back to form to a form with a bang.
runners.comment: All three turf wins have come here and he's worth chancing having dipped to good mark

runners.name: Miletus
runners.spotlight: Reacted well to first-time cheekpieces (added to tongue-tie) when edging ahead late on over C&D (good) four weeks ago; not the most convincing (carries head awkwardly under pressure) but he's only been nudged up 2lb.
runners.comment: Carries head awkwardly but he did edge ahead late on over C&D latest; only 2lb higher

runners.name: Jumby
runners.spotlight: On a three-year losing run and nothing like the force of old but his current mark reflects that and this is a good bit easier than the two handicaps he tackled in the spring; no surprise were this class dropper to go well with his yard among the winners.
runners.comment: On three-year losing run but no surprise were this 8yo still a force at this level

runners.name: Warrior Mode
runners.spotlight: Didn't build on a promising start on AW last spring, including well held in 1m Haydock handicap (good to soft) on sole turf start; has been gelded and had a second wind operation ahead of this return from eight months off; it's still early days but his profile isn't compelling.
runners.comment: Lightly raced but last season ended badly; been gelded and had second wind op

runners.name: I Still Have Faith
runners.spotlight: Threatened on AW and turf in the spring but his last two efforts have been below par (C&D latterly); feasibly handicapped but others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Threatened on AW and turf in spring but his last two efforts have been below par
runners.owner: J Morley D Reynolds C Watkins & Partner

runners.name: Bell Shot
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with 6f success at Southwell off 2lb higher; respectable third of ten over 7f at Epsom (good) 17 days ago; successful on his previous outing over C&D; this prominent racer is capable of making a bold bid.
runners.comment: Won off 2lb higher on AW earlier in year and successful on previous C&D visit
runners.owner: SBK Racing & B & J Parr Racing Ltd

runners.name: Flag Of St George
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who won two 7f turf handicaps last summer; also close second off 1lb higher at Lingfield (7f) in December but his form dipped in two subsequent starts last winter; off for 169 days so his peak fitness has to be taken on trust.
runners.comment: Out of sorts when last seen in winter and peak fitness not assured after 169 days off

races.race_name: Club 26 At Ascot Handicap

runners.name: Fenlander
runners.spotlight: Took 17 attempts to get off the mark but now on a four-timer after wins at Leicester (twice) and Nottingham in recent months (all 6f on good/good to firm); only up another 2lb and merits plenty of respect in his current mood.
runners.comment: Completed hat-trick in May/June and only another 2lb higher as he bids for four in row

runners.name: Generous Rascal
runners.spotlight: Kempton novice win (6f, AW) for Oliver Cole last October; respectable efforts in 6f/7f handicaps for new yard this year and first-time cheekpieces won't need to give him too much extra having been eased a further 2lb.
runners.comment: Respectable efforts for new yard and won't need to pull out much more for headgear

runners.name: Yes I'm Mali
runners.spotlight: Beat his 17 rivals at Thirsk (6f, good) in April, his second run for David O'Meara, and there have been a couple of good second-place finishes since, including over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; a bold show is on the cards.
runners.comment: Pretty good record for this yard, including second over C&D latest; bold show likely

runners.name: Dashing Dick
runners.spotlight: Goes well on both Newmarket courses, including a win in this race on good to firm two years ago; good third over C&D last month but behind Yes I'm Mali when only sixth back here a fortnight ago.
runners.comment: Won this race two years ago; third over C&D last month but behind Yes I'm Mali latest

runners.name: Spring Bloom
runners.spotlight: Runner-up for the third time in five starts since joining John Butler when best of the rest behind the well-treated Ancient State (won next time) in 16-runner race over C&D (good) 29 days ago; same mark today.
runners.comment: In good form since joining John Butler, including second over C&D latest

runners.name: Lili Marleen
runners.spotlight: Winner over 1m on AW at Chantilly at the end of 2025 but below par on completed outing there (unseated start second occasion) at the beginning of 2026; well held over hurdles at Dieppe (2m1f, soft) in April (only start for Noel George & Amanda Zetterholm) and can only really watch dropped to sprinting for another new yard.
runners.comment: Both wins around 1m; ran over hurdles latest; best watched tried sprinting by new yard

runners.name: Expert Agent
runners.spotlight: C&D winner on good to firm last year; bounced back to form to win over 6f on the Rowley course here (good) in May; a lesser effort over C&D has followed but a revival isn't ruled out.
runners.comment: C&D winner last June; won on other course here in May but only sixth over C&D latest
runners.owner: J P Morris, Mrs V A Tunnicliffe Et Al

runners.name: Westmorian
runners.spotlight: 6-21 on AW but still seeking a first turf win after 15 attempts; latest Thirsk fourth (6f, good to firm) as good as anything he's produced on the grass but may find at least the odd one too strong again.
runners.comment: Latest Thirsk fourth creditable but he's 0-15 on turf compared to 6-21 on AW

races.race_name: National Stud 'Confined' Handicap (For Horses With No More Than One Win)

runners.name: John Harrison
runners.spotlight: Step forward when keeping on at one pace in first handicap, on Lingfield AW (1m) in January; off the track and gelded after but he came home with a wet sail when a close third of six at Salisbury (1m, good to firm) recently; looks well worth a go at 1m2f; respected.
runners.comment: Step forward in two 1m handicaps, on AW and turf; well worth a go at 1m2f

runners.name: Ziggy's Avenger
runners.spotlight: Has found his level since handicapping over 1m, finishing close up on Kempton AW in May before showing the right spirit to hold off his rivals at Ripon (good); less convincing with his finishing effort at Windsor since but dam's side of pedigree suggests this trip could suit.
runners.comment: Game win at Ripon (1m) in June but less convincing since; now tries new trip
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing & Harry Kassap Llc

runners.name: Madjid
runners.spotlight: Looked likely to pick up a 1m2f handicap on the form of his first attempt in one, when runner-up at Doncaster in April, but that hasn't happened and he just plugged on at one pace when seventh of 11 at Newbury recently; down in grade but others higher up the list.
runners.comment: Promising 2nd on return over 1m2f; hasn't equalled the form since but down in grade
runners.owner: Dr Jamal Ahmadzadeh & Mrs D Swinburn

runners.name: Flag Of Eva
runners.spotlight: He's been up against some good rivals in his qualifying runs but has shown signs of ability and there's every chance he'll give a good show now switched to this new level.
runners.comment: Signs of ability against talented rivals; should give a good show now handicapping

runners.name: Pipily
runners.spotlight: Showed just modest form as a juvenile and she was beaten a fair way out on comeback in her first handicap, on Wolverhampton AW in first-time cheekpieces; upped to 1m2f with plenty to find.
runners.comment: Minor 2yo form and beaten a fair way out on handicap debut (1m, AW) in June

runners.name: Moon Warp
runners.spotlight: Out of unraced half-sister to Group 1 winners at 1m2f in Hong Kong; made no impact in four 2yo starts at about 7f but he did show some promise behind highly talented rivals (the winner just lost out in a recent Group 1 in France) on his Beverley debut and sharp AW tests wouldn't have suited after; everything points to improvement for the new trip now handicapping.
runners.comment: Hint of promise over 7f on sole turf start; should improve for 1m2f on handicap debut

races.race_name: Lodge At The National Stud Handicap

runners.name: Elan d'Or
runners.spotlight: Impressive winner of two of his three AW handicaps as 2yo, at 7f and 1m, and his reappearance fifth of nine on the Rowley course (1m, good to firm) in May hinted at better to come; never reached a challenging position over C&D in June but has less to do this time; has to be considered.
runners.comment: Impressive in two AW wins as 2yo; promising return on turf; never involved over C&D since

runners.name: Mythical Guest
runners.spotlight: Both wins at 1m2f in 2024 but he has run well over this C&D and, after a slow start to the year, he showed more when a close third of eight at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last week; on the premises again.
runners.comment: Both wins at 1m2f in 2024 but has C&D form; ran well latest; on the premises again

runners.name: Astrazar
runners.spotlight: Had some good 2yo form, as when winning both starts at about 7f, and this campaign has a somewhat luckless look to it so far, albeit slow starts aren't helping; his one start over 1m, in a valuable Carlisle handicap in May, was inconclusive regarding stamina but he remains of interest.
runners.comment: Good 2yo form at 7f; inconclusive regarding stamina in sole 1m run; remains of interest

runners.name: Silca Bay
runners.spotlight: Most of his handicaps on AW, winning three at 7f and 1m, but the return to turf is working quite well of late, gaining a first win on the surface at Goodwood (1m, good to soft) in June then checked in quite a promising run at Sandown (1m, good to firm) since; can be competitive off the same mark.
runners.comment: Three AW wins; doing well back on turf, winning at Goodwood then hampered at Sandown

runners.name: Dovey Moon
runners.spotlight: A stout stayer over 1m and Salisbury's stiff test suited him in May (good) where he overcame trouble in running to lead near the line; has had excuses since but he has a good run in him if this is truly run.
runners.comment: Suited by a thorough test at 1m; had excuses since May win; has possibilities

runners.name: Lady Mariko
runners.spotlight: Turf wins at 7f and latest success was over 6f on AW in April; has rarely tackled 1m and she was highly tried over this trip in the Kensington Palace at Royal Ascot in June but she did look to stay an extended 1m at Nottingham in 2025 for previous yard; has possibilities.
runners.comment: Has won at 7f (turf) and 6f (AW); seemed to stay 1m for previous yard; highly tried latest

runners.name: Rogue Encore
runners.spotlight: Best form at 1m on AW, winning three times on Newcastle Tapeta, but he wasn't doing so well when last seen in the spring and, although he has turf form at 1m, it's offputting he's seen so rarely on the surface.
runners.comment: All 3 wins on AW; below best in the spring; acts on turf but rarely seen on the surface

races.race_name: Hadwins Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Newbrook Diamond
runners.spotlight: Quite useful 6yo who made all and won comfortably at Wexford (2m4f, good) a fortnight ago; that first hurdling success (his eighth attempt) was somewhat overdue and his overall record is not entirely convincing but, nevertheless, he'll be hard to beat if all goes to plan here.
runners.comment: Quite useful 6yo who made all and won comfortably at Wexford this month; obvious player

runners.name: Viscountess Nelson
runners.spotlight: Won readily by nearly 5l at Perth (2m4f, good) in April, her second start over hurdles, and was not discredited when very close second at Fontwell (2m3f, good) last month; upped in trip here; ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Ready winner at Perth (2m4f) in May and not discredited when close second last month
runners.owner: Old Gold Racing With Francesca Cumani

runners.name: Rebel Tribesman
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who came second on first two hurdling starts (2m1f) and didn't need to improve to justify skinny odds at Warwick (2m3f, good) in May; upped in trip again here and probably still has more to offer.
runners.comment: Didn't need to improve to win at Warwick (2m3f) in May; up on trip here; respected

runners.name: Order Another One
runners.spotlight: Joined Dianne Sayer after winning mares' maiden on her seventh start pointing in Ireland; tailed off here (2m1f, good) on rules debut three weeks ago; upped in trip with hood added today.
runners.comment: Irish point winner; tailed off here (2m1f) on recent rules debut; upped in trip and hooded

runners.name: Frisky Whiskey
runners.spotlight: Only beaten about 8l when fourth of eight at Hexham (2m4f, good; first-time tongue-tie) last month, her second hurdle run, but that form looks modest she has a fair bit to find here.
runners.comment: Not beaten far when fourth at Hexham last month but the form looks modest

runners.name: Manhatane
runners.spotlight: Showed little in two points this spring and was well beaten over C&D (good) on rules debut three weeks ago.
runners.comment: Well beaten over C&D (good) on rules debut three weeks ago

races.race_name: Cartmel Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Alvesta
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to win C&D (good) selling handicap for George Bewley in May, her tenth hurdling start, and also ran well when third here (2m6f, good) on last month's stable debut; this drop back in trip is probably the right move; ought to make her presence felt.
runners.comment: Won C&D selling handicap in May and also ran well over 2m6f for new yard here last month

runners.name: Mr Globalist
runners.spotlight: Ran well to a point when fourth in C&D selling handicap won by Alvesta in May but was beaten about 19l in the end and has been safely held in two subsequent chases; 3lb wrong today and now 0-40 under rules.
runners.comment: Ran well to a point over C&D in May but held in two chases since; now 0-40 under rules

runners.name: Animato
runners.spotlight: Ran well for a long way when third of seven on latest hurdling start, at Doncaster (2m, soft) in February, and will be fine on the faster ground here but recent Flat form has been underwhelming; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Ran okay on latest hurdling start (February) but recent Flat form has been underwhelming

runners.name: King Kodiak
runners.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles and prone to clumsy jumping; belied 33-1 odds when second at Perth (2m, good) last month and didn't run badly over 2m4f there 16 days ago but others look less risky.
runners.comment: 33-1 second at Perth last month but prone to clumsy jumping and comes with risk

runners.name: Mr Lincoln
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles but made the frame on last three attempts, losing out only by a short head on one occasion; placed twice on the Flat lately will be suited by today's trip/ground; good chance.
runners.comment: 0-10 over hurdles but has knocked on the door this year; also in good form on Flat lately

runners.name: Daring To Dream
runners.spotlight: Launched handicap career with two respectable runs (both 2m, good) towards end of last season but, following a wind op, took backward step when safely held at Uttoxeter on Wednesday; sports refitted hood here; improvement required.
runners.comment: First two handicap runs were respectable; Uttoxeter on Wednesday was a backward step

runners.name: Made All
runners.spotlight: Four-time Flat winner who finished third in both his handicap hurdles, the latter at Market Rasen (2m, good) in May; seemed to give the leaders far too much rope when beaten at skinny odds on the Flat on Wednesday but that run was still good enough to confirm his wellbeing; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Four-time Flat winner who finished third in both handicap hurdles; shortlisted

runners.name: Ribble River
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer with three middle-distance wins on his CV; yet to show any significant promise after four hurdle starts this year but has lowly mark for this handicap debut and some of that Flat ability may yet transfer to this discipline; watch the betting.
runners.comment: Yet to show any significant hurdling promise but Flat form makes him of interest
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Mrs C Clark Miss A Lee

races.race_name: RF Miller & Co Female Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle (Female Professional Jockeys & Amateur Riders' Race)

runners.name: Eternal Angel
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 6yo who is 2-3 in maiden/novice hurdles for new stable this season, the latter win gained by 18l at Uttoxeter (2m, good; first-time hood) 11 days ago; faces tougher opposition on this British handicap debut but still commands respect.
runners.comment: 2-3 in novice company for new stable this season; commands respect on handicap return

runners.name: Percy Shelley
runners.spotlight: Runner-up (albeit no match for winner) off today's mark at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) in May and didn't run badly on the Flat (1m6f) last month; could yet have a bigger effort in him over jumps but this drop back in trip may not be in his favour.
runners.comment: Second over 2m4f off this mark in May but this drop back in trip may not be in his favour

runners.name: Saligo Bay
runners.spotlight: Progressive on the Flat and over hurdles last year, collecting eight wins (one over C&D) in total; absent since respectable fifth in Scottish County Hurdle at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in January, though, and current mark demands another personal best.
runners.comment: Progressive on the Flat and over hurdles last year (eight wins); returns from a break

runners.name: My Chiquita
runners.spotlight: Built upon pleasing stable debut when coming from off the pace for C&D (good) success under Leah Noreci in May; subsequent 3lb rise ought to be manageable and she can make her presence felt again.
runners.comment: Came from off the pace for C&D win in May and subsequent 3lb rise ought to be manageable

runners.name: Norman Fletcher
runners.spotlight: Appreciated drop to 0-110 grade when second under Amber Jackson-Fennell at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good; wore cheekpieces) last month but is not as good as he was and needs change of headgear to give him a boost here.
runners.comment: Fair second when dropped in grade last month but not as good as he was; others preferred

runners.name: Ladies Day
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a Listed bumper last season and 2-3 since switched to hurdles this spring, having beaten subsequent wide-margin winner Eternal Angel at Uttoxeter on latest outing; must be considered on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Placed in a Listed bumper and 2-3 over hurdles; must be considered on this handicap debut

runners.name: Well Educated
runners.spotlight: Runner-up three consecutive times at Hexham (2m-2m4f, good) this spring and also suited by this track but his latest run was below par and he's 2lb wrong today.
runners.comment: Second three times at Hexham this spring but latest run was below par and he's 2lb wrong

runners.name: Buddah Castle
runners.spotlight: Won four-runner Sedgefield maiden (2m4f, soft) in December and remains unexposed under rules but his next two hurdle runs were disappointing and he unseated rider mid-race on last month's chase/handicap debut; dropped in trip and reverts to hurdling today; others have more obvious claims.
runners.comment: Unseated rider mid-race on recent chase/handicap debut; down in trip for hurdle return
runners.owner: T Alderson & Ales And Dales Syndicate

runners.name: Winds Of Winter
runners.spotlight: Not quite at his best this year but last month's Hexham third was respectable and she remains only 2lb higher than when beating Saligo Bay to win this race under Thomasina Eyston in 2025; can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Not quite at best this year but only 2lb higher than when winning this in 2025

runners.name: Heart Above
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form with narrow win at Kelso (2m5f, good) in May but that seems to be his favourite track and he ran poorly here (2m6f) last month; this drop back in trip is not ideal; not the percentage call.
runners.comment: Narrow winner at Kelso in May but quickly back in the doldrums here last month

runners.name: Secret Force
runners.spotlight: Won a juvenile hurdle for Gavin Cromwell at Punchestown (2m, good to yielding) in October and was also on target in 2m2f Flat marathon for new stable in June; still unexposed over jumps; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Won on the Flat for new stable last month and remains unexposed over jumps; interesting

races.race_name: Cartmel Crystal Cup Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Belles Benefit
runners.spotlight: Returned from eight-month break in excellent form three weeks ago, winning comfortably by 10l over C&D (good); 8lb higher in higher-grade race today but still considered.
runners.comment: Returned from break in excellent form three weeks ago, winning comfortably by 10l over C&D

runners.name: Rauzan
runners.spotlight: Belied 40-1 odds when creditable third at Kelso (2m5f, good to soft; wore cheekpieces) in March but weakened quickly after making a lot of the running over C&D (good; visored, as today) three weeks ago and is now 0-9 for stable; needs recent wind op to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: Weakened quickly over C&D last month and now 0-9 for stable; had recent wind op

runners.name: Oakley
runners.spotlight: In career-best form this season, most notably when coming from the rear to win Class 2 handicap at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) three weeks ago; still unexposed over this sort of trip; might be the answer.
runners.comment: In career-best form this season, most recently winning Uttoxeter Class 2 three weeks ago

runners.name: Evenwood Sonofagun
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner, most recently in May; needs to bounce back from below-par run here three weeks ago but probably still on a workable mark; dangerous to ignore.
runners.comment: Didn't fire here last time but this three-time C&D winner is still on a workable mark
runners.owner: Mrs D Chapman & Mrs E Quinlan

runners.name: Roaring Home
runners.spotlight: Won twice on good ground this spring (2m7f/2m4f) and last month's close second at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) was a career-best performance; likely contender again here.
runners.comment: Won twice in spring and last month's close second was career-best form; likely contender

runners.name: High Dancer
runners.spotlight: Came good for current stable at Hexham (2m, good) last month, his second run in cheekpieces; up 4lb to career-high mark but will be suited by this move back up in trip and is evidently in good nick.
runners.comment: On career-high mark after recent 2m Hexham win but this longer trip will also suit

runners.name: Peaky Boy
runners.spotlight: Unraced over hurdles since winning Cheltenham novice in 2024 but recent 2m7f/3m chase form has been very respectable and he's edging down the weights; swaps cheekpieces for first-time blinkers; could have a say.
runners.comment: Unraced over hurdles since 2024 but recent chase form has been very respectable

runners.name: Tommie Beau
runners.spotlight: Popular veteran who runs this track well and capitalised upon some significant help from the handicapper when winning Norfolk National at Fakenham (3m5f, good) in May; this drop back in trip is not ideal on his return to hurdling, though; cheekpieces (worn for last three races) left off today.
runners.comment: Popular staying chaser who runs this track well; this drop is trip is not ideal, though

runners.name: Caughtinyourtrance
runners.spotlight: In good form over fences here since wind op in April, most notably when winning over 3m1f (good) three weeks ago; should be fine back over this hurdles and over this shorter trip; respected in current mood.
runners.comment: In good form over fences here this season (won last time) and should be fine back hurdling

runners.name: Dinons
runners.spotlight: Teenager who was useful in his prime and is well handicapped on form as recent as the autumn; returned from break with satisfactory run in June but was well beaten on only previous visit to Cartmel; younger rivals preferred.
runners.comment: Ran okay in June, after a break, but younger rivals appeal more all the same

runners.name: Shantwopointfive
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner for Warren Greatrex; ran as though something was amiss on latest outing in January and was sold for £10,000 in May but starts off for new stable on workable mark; tongue-tie on; market helpful.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner for Warren Greatrex; off since poor run in January; makes stable debut

runners.name: Howdoyalikeherhome
runners.spotlight: Returned from break with two underwhelming chase runs this season and unseated rider when back over hurdles in plating company 12 days ago; tricky to weigh up at present but represents respected Irish stable.
runners.comment: Tricky to weigh up at present but represents respected Irish stable

runners.name: Homme Public
runners.spotlight: Well below best during five-race campaign last season but took step back in right direction when third over fences at Bangor (2m1f, good) two months ago; remains on good mark for this hurdle return and could plausibly be better suited by this sort of trip nowadays; cheekpieces replace blinkers.
runners.comment: Not the force of old but his chase run in May was a step back in the right direction

races.race_name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Chase

runners.name: Star Turn
runners.spotlight: Returned from long absence with two hurdling seconds this spring (visored) and filled same position behind Kingofthegame in C&D chase three weeks ago (good; first-time blinkers); not yet exposed over fences; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Close second to Kingofthegame over C&D last month and not yet exposed over fences

runners.name: Kingofthegame
runners.spotlight: Came good with game hurdle win here (3m1f, good) in May and fended off Star Turn to follow up in C&D (good) chase three weeks ago; makes obvious appeal in current form.
runners.comment: Came good over hurdles here in May and followed up in C&D chase last month

runners.name: Halfway House Lad
runners.spotlight: Started off for James Moffatt with two good-ground wins in May, the latter over C&D; ran as though something was amiss here three weeks ago but could still have more improvement to come for new stable if quickly back on song; cheekpieces (worn twice in 2024) are given another whirl.
runners.comment: Ran as though something was amiss last time but started off for stable with two wins

runners.name: Dreamings Free
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with two poor hurdle runs for Maurice Barnes and was also well beaten when reappearing for new stable this month (first-time hood); makes chasing debut with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Well beaten over hurdles on recent stable debut; 1lb wrong for chasing debut

runners.name: Judicial Review
runners.spotlight: Gained all three chase wins at this track (2m5f-3m1f) and has slipped to a dangerous mark but looked out of sorts on both starts here last month (2m5f/3m1f) and now has questions to answer.
runners.comment: Three course wins; on very good mark now but out of sorts on both starts here last month

runners.name: Jeteye
runners.spotlight: Not seen over fences since two disappointing attempts in spring 2024 but in good form over hurdles, notably when winning at Hexham (2m7f, good) in May; reverts to chasing on a lower mark; player if able to find some fluency.
runners.comment: First chase run since two disappointing attempts in 2024 but in good form over hurdles

runners.name: Wearelongterm
runners.spotlight: Placed in two 2m7f Kelso chases in the autumn (good/good to soft) but absent since below-par hurdle run in February and returns with rules strike-rate standing at 0-21.
runners.comment: Placed in two chases in the autumn but absent since below-par hurdle run in February
runners.owner: Dennis J Coppola & Mrs Dianne Sayer

runners.name: Lights Are Green
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner (including this race in 2024); good third to Halfway House over C&D in May, after a break, but pulled up after looking reluctant (not for the first time) at Hexham last month and comes with risk.
runners.comment: Runs this track well but sometimes looks reluctant nowadays; comes with risk

runners.name: Roxboro River
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice over hurdles in recent weeks, latterly in refitted cheekpieces at Worcester (2m7f, good), but was well beaten in both chases last year and needs to prove he can transfer his recent good form to fences.
runners.comment: Second twice over hurdles in recent weeks but was well beaten in both previous chases

runners.name: Tell Me Again
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; not beaten that far when fifth of seven here (2m5f, good) three weeks ago and might be better suited by today's trip but others in this line-up have much more obvious claims.
runners.comment: Not beaten that far over 2m5f here last month but improvement is required

races.race_name: Shorefield Supplies Handicap Chase

runners.name: Cawthorne Cracker
runners.spotlight: Triple hurdle winner who is 0-8 over fences but he's on a dangerous mark and wasn't beaten far when third at Market Rasen (2m2f, good) on penultimate run; has possibilities if he can get back near that level and yard is in good form; wore blinkers last time but regular cheekpieces now return.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark and he wasn't beaten far at Market Rasen on penultimate run; in the mix

runners.name: Dexter
runners.spotlight: Defied this mark over C&D (good) last August but he's been out of sorts in his last three runs and latest was at Cartmel three weeks ago; has something to prove and he needs to get back on track; blinkers are removed and cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Defied this mark over C&D last August but he's been out of sorts in last three runs

runners.name: Clean Getaway
runners.spotlight: Record of 5-18 over fences but all of those wins have come at Sedgefield (2m/2m4f); only 2lb higher than for his last win in April but he's not gone on from that and was a well-held fifth of seven over C&D (good; 16-1) last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: All of his five chase wins have come at Sedgefield and was well held over C&D last time

runners.name: Out On Her Own
runners.spotlight: Overall record of 0-12 but she's unexposed over fences and went clear some way out before fading into a 9l fourth here (2m5f, good) three weeks ago; continues to edge down the weights and she could make a bold bid on this drop back in trip; hood removed.
runners.comment: Made a bold bid over 2m5f here last time and she's an interesting contender back in trip

runners.name: Forsa Bay
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden who has a patchy profile and made it 0-5 over fences when pulled up at Market Rasen (2m6f, good) in May; comes with risks attached but he may have had stamina issues last time and he looks interesting on his placed effort at Hereford (2m, good) in March; tongue-tie and cheekpieces are removed and visor returns.
runners.comment: Pulled up at Market Rasen (2m6f) but he may have had stamina issues and could bounce back

runners.name: Getaway Jewel
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner who bounced back with a close second at Uttoxeter (2m, good) 11 days ago; 3lb higher here but he remains well treated on old form and all of his wins have been under Brian Hughes; key player.
runners.comment: Bounced back with a close second at Uttoxeter (2m) 11 days ago; big player again up 3lb

runners.name: Blazing Court
runners.spotlight: Won off 16lb higher at Worcester (2m4f, good) in August 2024 but he's lost his way and has failed to complete in his last three runs; has lots to prove and he needs a major revival on this big drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Has lost his way and he's failed to complete in last three starts; lots to prove

runners.name: Cuzco Du Mathan
runners.spotlight: Both wins over fences came over C&D in 2024; well handicapped on his old form but he's generally struggled in the last 12 months and was last of seven over C&D (good) when last seen in May; plenty to prove and all of his wins have been on soft or heavy ground.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner but all of his wins have been in the mud and he was tailed off here latest

races.race_name: Charnley's Home & Garden Centre Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Lermoos Legend
runners.spotlight: Nine-time chase winner including twice at Cartmel; didn't fire at Worcester in May but that was after a close second at Ffos Las (2m4f, good) and he's a player if he can recapture that form; not ruled out for yard that won this last year.
runners.comment: Close second at Ffos Las (2m4f) in April and has claims if he can recapture that form

runners.name: Got Grey
runners.spotlight: Won twice over hurdles and once over fences for Dan Skelton; wasn't beaten far when third of three on stable debut here (2m1f, good) in May but he was well held in another small-field event over C&D last time; still lightly raced over fences but he needs to step up again after that last run; cheekpieces reapplied.
runners.comment: Lightly raced over fences but he was well held over C&D three weeks ago; bit to prove

runners.name: Sean Og
runners.spotlight: All five wins over fences have been at this track and latest was over C&D (good) in May; didn't shine here last time but that was a Class 2 handicap and he still looks on a workable mark; respected on this big drop back in grade.
runners.comment: All five chase wins have been at Cartmel and latest was on his penultimate run; respected

runners.name: Moodofthemoment
runners.spotlight: Has won four chases and latest was at Newcastle in October (2m4f, good); well handicapped on that form but he's been disappointing since and was pulled up at Perth two weeks ago.
runners.comment: Won at Newcastle last October but he's been disappointing since and was pulled up latest

runners.name: Passengerontheship
runners.spotlight: Major improver who made it 5-7 over fences when completing a five-timer over C&D (good) three weeks ago; up another 5lb but he's on a roll and this tough 7yo could continue on the upgrade; big player.
runners.comment: Made it 5-7 over fences when completing a five-timer over C&D last month; big player

runners.name: Red Happy
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick at around 3m during the opening quarter of 2025 but following a year off he's refused to race on two occasions and was pulled up here (3m1f, good) last time.
runners.comment: Following a year off he's refused to race on two occasions and was pulled up last time

races.race_name: Go Racing In Yorkshire Summer Festival Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Come On Over
runners.spotlight: Shaded a tight finish to get off the mark at the 12th attempt here (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago; drop back to the minimum trip not sure to suit but arrives here in top form.
runners.comment: Shaded a tight finish to get off the mark over 6f last time; 5f not sure to suit
runners.owner: Come On Over Syndicate & A H Yates Ltd

runners.name: J Street
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a declining mark to register her first AW/handicap win, at Southwell (5f) last month; hung right throughout when fourth of five at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) since; should not be far away if on her best behaviour.
runners.comment: Won at Southwell last month but hung right throughout when fourth at Hamilton last time.

runners.name: Ancient Times
runners.spotlight: Scored off a career-low mark to land his eighth success, at Epsom (6f, good to firm) nine days ago; back up 2lb but has recorded back-to-back wins previously so cannot be discounted.
runners.comment: Scored off career-low mark to land his eighth success, at Epsom nine days ago; back up 2lb

runners.name: Startling
runners.spotlight: All four wins have came on AW but has been placed on her last two runs on turf; needs a shade more to win but not out of this.
runners.comment: All four wins have came on AW but has been placed on her last two runs on turf.

runners.name: Wyle Cop
runners.spotlight: Landed a Wolverhampton maiden (6f, AW) in March; has been found wanting in six handicaps since but he wasn't disgraced at Newbury last week and is down to a career-low mark on the return to 5f; place claims.
runners.comment: Landed a Wolverhampton maiden in March but has been found wanting in six handicaps since.

runners.name: Papa Don't Preach
runners.spotlight: All four wins on AW; not beaten far when third over C&D in April but ran no sort of race when last of nine over C&D when last seen in May; another headgear switch and is becoming frustrating.
runners.comment: Third over C&D in April but ran no sort of race when last of nine over C&D in May.

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sanbona Warrior
runners.spotlight: Out of a 7f winning half-sister to Group 3 scorer Breathtaking Look; well backed into 5-1 on Kempton debut (7f, AW) last month and he made a bold bid before finishing a clear second; that was a promising start and he sets a fair standard; key player.
runners.comment: Well backed when runner-up on Kempton AW debut and he sets the standard on that form
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Keep Grating
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise on his Salisbury debut (6f, good to firm) last month and he built on that when third of seven behind a smart rival at Ascot last Friday; was beaten around 6l in that race but he rallied in the closing stages and is open to more progress at this new trip; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Promising third behind a smart rival at Ascot last week and he's respected upped in trip

runners.name: Regalism
runners.spotlight: 43,000euros yearling, £48,000 breeze-up 2yo; thirteenth foal; brother to 6f AW winner Elvetham (RPR 66), half-brother to four Flat winners including Dragoon Guard (8.6f AW 2yo; 84) and Gertcha (1m AW; 73); dam placed 12.5f in France, half-sister to smart 6f-1m4f winner Mons; interesting newcomer and he needs a close look for top yard.
runners.comment: Brother to a winner and half-brother to four more; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Coco Nova
runners.spotlight: 65,000euros yearling; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to smart French 1m/1m1f winner Kokaltash, out of French 1m3f winner from family of Derby winner High Chaparral; yard 18% with 2yos this season and he needs watching in the market on debut.
runners.comment: 65,000euros yearling; yard 18% with 2yos this season and he needs watching in market

runners.name: Darrington Golf
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns foal; third foal; dam unraced sister to 1m4f winners La Joya and Empyrea, out of useful maiden half-sister to 7f/1m Group 1 winner Belardo; has good standard to aim at on debut and he could be a longer-term prospect.
runners.comment: Has good standard to aim at on debut and he could be a longer-term prospect

runners.name: Hello You Ten
runners.spotlight: 120,000euros foal, 42,000gns yearling; closely related to winners Madeline (6f 2yo including Listed; RPR 105) and Tiberia (French 7f 2yo), half-brother to 10.5f-1m6f winner Adeline (93); dam Swiss 1m1f-1m4f winner, sister to French 6f/7f Listed winner Dolma; already been gelded and market should guide on debut.
runners.comment: 42,000gns yearling; well-related gelding and market should guide on debut

runners.name: Claret Time
runners.spotlight: Well held at a big price on Redcar debut (6f, good) last month and same story at Thirsk 17 days ago; has lots to find upped in trip and nurseries will be more suitable.
runners.comment: Well held in both his runs and has lots to find upped in trip

runners.name: Hadlan
