runners.spotlight: RPRs in the 50s when well held in 6f novice events at Nottingham (good) and Wolverhampton (AW) last month; hood is now added and he needs lots of improvement upped in trip.
runners.comment: Well held in two runs last month and he needs lots of improvement upped in trip; hood on

runners.name: Whisper Angel
runners.spotlight: 66-1 and she didn't show much after a slow start at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago; best watched.
runners.comment: 66-1 and she didn't show much after a slow start at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) on debut

runners.name: The Monkey King
runners.spotlight: 5-1 on Kempton debut (7f, AW) last month but he faded into sixth of 11 and was almost 8l behind Sanbona Warrior; should benefit from that experience but he needs a transformation on his second start.
runners.comment: 5-1 on Kempton debut (7f, AW) last month but he finished almost 8l behind Sanbona Warrior

races.race_name: Lakeside Village Is 30 Handicap

runners.name: First Time
runners.spotlight: Newmarket maiden winner for Harry Charlton last August (6f, good to firm); subsequently sold for 90,000gns; best run for the Faheys when third at Chester last time; (7f, good); on a fair mark; a possible.
runners.comment: Ex-Harry Charlton; 90,000gns buy; best run for new yard when 3rd last time; a possible

runners.name: Yorkshire
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who hasn't won on turf since May 2024, when dead-heating at Thirsk (7f, good to firm); down the field in two decent handicaps this season but beaten less than 6l on each occasion and takes a significant drop in grade; has to be considered.
runners.comment: Fair form in decent handicaps this term; takes a big drop in grade; has to be considered

runners.name: Perfect Part
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut in the Hilary Needler at Beverley two years ago (5f, good to firm) but hasn't won since; fair second in a Thirsk fillies' handicap two runs ago (1m, good) but well beaten at Royal Ascot last time.
runners.comment: Won on debut in 2022, but not scored since; fair 2nd in May but well held at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Talis Evolvere
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden on turf (1m, good to soft) in 2023, but his other wins have been on the AW; beaten only 2l when seventh of 11 over  C&D last time; each-way chance.
runners.comment: Won maiden on turf in 2023; other wins on AW; beaten 2l over C&D last time; place chance

runners.name: Egoli
runners.spotlight: Highly tried after winning a York maiden (6f, good to firm) and a Newbury novice (6f, good) last season; gelded in November; disappointing this season; first run at 7f.
runners.comment: Highly tried after two 6f wins last term (then gelded); below par this term; now tries 7f

runners.name: Daydreama
runners.spotlight: Two novice wins over 6f last term (good); best run this term when second in a York handicap in May (7f, good); disappointing since; fast ground is a concern.
runners.comment: Two 6f novice wins last term; good 2nd at York in May; bit disappointing since

runners.name: Akkadian Thunder
runners.spotlight: In good form last June, winning off this mark over C&D (good) before an excellent second at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm); some fair efforts this season and on a good mark now; not out of it.
runners.comment: Best run this time when 3rd over C&D in June; creditable runs since; on a good mark

runners.name: Christian David
runners.spotlight: Four wins over 7f/1m, two on the AW; fair third at Newmarket in April (1m, good) but not so good since; acts on any ground although withdrawn on account of the going (officially good to firm) last time.
runners.comment: Four wins, two on AW; fair third in April but slightly below par on last two runs

runners.name: Kodi Lion
runners.spotlight: Won over 6f at Haydock in May 2025 (good) and a couple of fair runs over 7f after that; acts on fast ground but he lacks a recent run (has been off since October).
runners.comment: 6f Haydock winner last year; some fair runs over 7f after that; off since October
runners.owner: D J Cash & Mrs E Cash Racing

races.race_name: Summer Fun At Lakeside Village Outlet Shopping Handicap

runners.name: Wilde And Dandy
runners.spotlight: Both turf wins have been over C&D on good to firm, the latest last August; close third to a subsequent winner at Yarmouth last time (7f, good to firm) and has a fair chance here.
runners.comment: Both turf wins have been over C&D on fast ground; good third at Yarmouth last time

runners.name: Thapa Vc
runners.spotlight: Ran three sound races in June, notably when 0.75l third over C&D (good to firm) then beaten a head at Bath next time (1m, good); below par on AW latest but has an each-way chance back on turf.
runners.comment: Three sound races in June, including C&D third; below par on AW since; chance back on turf

runners.name: Havana Mojito
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been over 7f/1m on good/good to firm at Brighton; has finished second over 7f/1m there in blinkers on last three runs; each-way chance.
runners.comment: All three wins over 7f/1m at Brighton; second there on last three starts; each-way chance

runners.name: Big Apple Jack
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden; two decent seconds this season, including last time when beaten 1.25l in a 6f handicap at Pontefract (good; ran on well in closing stages); interesting on first try at 7f.
runners.comment: 0-13; running-on second over 6f at Pontefract last time; interesting on this step up to 7f

runners.name: War And Love
runners.spotlight: Ex-Sir Mark Prescott; beaten more than 8l in two starts for Brian Ellison this term, over 1m at Redcar and Ripon; bit to prove.
runners.comment: Ex-Sir Mark Prescott; beaten more than 8l in two runs over 1m for new yard

runners.name: Maxi Boy
runners.spotlight: Only turf win was at Yarmouth on his debut in 2019 (6f, good to firm); best runs this season have been over 6f/7f here, including last time when 2.5l fourth over 6f; each-way chance.
runners.comment: 1-27 on turf, his win on debut in 2019; two fair runs here this term; each-way chance

runners.name: Travis
runners.spotlight: Back to form when winning at Redcar in June (7f, good) and finished a sound third off 6lb higher at Beverley last time (7.5f, good to firm); down 1lb; a possible.
runners.comment: Back to form to win at Redcar in June; good third on good to firm last time; a possible

runners.name: Renewable Dream
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; showed some promise for Seb Spencer but well beaten on last three starts; makes stable debut after a 173-day break.
runners.comment: 0-9; some promise for Seb Spencer (below par last three starts); back after 173-day break

races.race_name: Summer Saturdays At Doncaster Handicap

runners.name: Willow Wood
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns breeze-up 2yo; well held in her first four starts but she found lots of improvement upped to 1m4f when an easy winner of a Ffos Las handicap (good to soft) last month; this is a different test on quicker ground but a 6lb rise looks fair and she's a half-sister to a Listed winner on good to firm; major player.
runners.comment: Off the mark with an easy win at Ffos Las and a 6lb rise looks fair; big player

runners.name: Boilermaker
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but he went close in a Thirsk handicap (1m4f, good) in May and backed that up with a creditable third in similar conditions at Goodwood last month; on the same mark as last time and he should be in the mix again; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: 0-6 but he's finished close up in 1m4f handicaps on last two starts; in the mix
runners.owner: W G & A G Vestey, E Gerber And P Inglett

runners.name: Royal Poetry
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when making all in a novice at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) in April; runner-up in two of her three handicaps since but she was no match for the winner at Salisbury (1m2f, soft) last time; still lightly raced but she needs more improvement at this new trip.
runners.comment: Lightly raced filly who needs more improvement at this new trip
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Rossa Raheen
runners.spotlight: Had two races for David Menuisier and four for current trainer; nearly won at Newbury in May and she was a creditable fourth there (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago; has shaped as though this step up to 1m4f could suit and she's an interesting contender.
runners.comment: Good fourth at Newbury latest and she looks interesting on this step up to 1m4f

runners.name: That Darn Cantor
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival in three of his four runs including when last of six on handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good; first run since gelded) last month; still early days but he needs a transformation on this step up to 1m4f; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival in three of his four runs; headgear is now added at this new trip

runners.name: Tai Hang Pegasus
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but he ran well upped to 1m4f when a staying-on second in an Epsom handicap (good to firm) last week; hit a personal best behind an unexposed rival in that race and he's respected off the same mark.
runners.comment: 0-7 but was runner-up behind an improver at Epsom (1m4f) last week; respected

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap

runners.name: Woodleigh
runners.spotlight: Won at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) in May and over C&D in June (good to soft; 18-runner handicap); beaten 8l on AW last time; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Has a chance on his 2 wins in the spring, and is much better than he showed last time (AW)

runners.name: Palmarian
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on first run over 1m at Leicester (good to firm) two weeks ago, despite not getting the best of runs; should go well again off 2lb higher.
runners.comment: Off the mark on first try at 1m at Leicester last time; can go well off 2lb higher
runners.owner: MDP Racing And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: First Encounter
runners.spotlight: Both turf wins have been at 1m on good to firm; has won twice in blinkers on AW this year; although not in top form last twice, these conditions are ideal and could go well on this return to turf.
runners.comment: Two AW wins with blinkers in 2026; these conditions suit; could go well on return to turf

runners.name: Electric Lightning
runners.spotlight: C&D winner off 1lb lower last July (good); best run this term when runner-up to a subsequent winner at Beverley last time (7.5f, good to firm; fifth has also won since); solid chance.
runners.comment: C&D winner last term; best run this season when 2nd at Beverley last time; can go well

runners.name: Oscar's Sister
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-21, the win in September 2022; fair fourth over 7f at Redcar two runs back, but not so good there next time (1m); others preferred.
runners.comment: 1-27, the win coming back in 2022; fair 4th two runs back but not so good last time

runners.name: Clasina
runners.spotlight: Ex-Katie Scott; off the mark on stable debut at Yarmouth last August (7f, good to firm); tailed off over 6f on reappearance in June on first run since; now tries 1m again (well beaten two previous attempts at the trip).
runners.comment: Won over 7f on stable debut in August; tailed off on reappearance (6f); now tries 1m again

runners.name: Ribston Pippin
runners.spotlight: Two wins last season, the first over 1m at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm); two heavy defeats on turf this season (beaten 23l at Yarmouth last time); returns after a 59-day break.
runners.comment: Two wins last term but two heavy defeats on turf in 2026; back after 59-day break

runners.name: Princess Niyla
runners.spotlight: Two of three wins over 1m2f at Beverley, the latest in May 2025; some fair efforts at 1m-1m4f this season; on a decent mark now.
runners.comment: Two of three wins were over 1m2f; some fair efforts from 1m-1m4f this term; on a fair mark

runners.name: Give Me The Night
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; creditable fifth of seven in first-time blinkers at Yarmouth last time (1m, good to firm); headgear retained; each-way chance.
runners.comment: 0-10; creditable fifth of seven in first-time headgear (retained) last time; place chance

runners.name: Penny Ghent
runners.spotlight: In good form, winning at Ripon (1m, good) and Beverley (8.5f, good to firm) before a decent third off this mark (10lb higher than second win) back at Beverley last time (8.5f, good to firm); should go well.
runners.comment: Running well at present, following two wins with a good 3rd off this mark last time

runners.name: Relevant Range
runners.spotlight: 1-27 on turf; has a chance on his head second at Musselburgh in June (1m, good) but well beaten back on the AW last time.
runners.comment: 1-27 on turf; chance on his head second at Musselburgh in June; well beaten latest (AW)

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap

runners.name: An Bradan Feasa
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat and four-time hurdle winner who has finished runner-up at Lingfield (2m, AW/good) in his two Flat runs this year; still looks feasibly treated in this sphere and he ran respectably back over jumps at Uttoxeter on Wednesday; respected.
runners.comment: Runner-up in his two Flat runs (2m) this year and he's respected back in this sphere

runners.name: Tabasko
runners.spotlight: Dam is related to St Leger winner Hurricane Lane and Group-class stayer Sweet William; consistent form in her first five starts but she raised her game upped to 1m4f when runner-up in an Epsom handicap (good) 17 days ago; nudged up 2lb but she kept on well and is open to more progress now switched to a staying trip; needs a close look.
runners.comment: Second at Epsom last time and she could find more progress now switched to a staying trip

runners.name: Pyleates
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but she ran her best race so far when close second in a Sandown handicap (1m6f, good) two weeks ago; has shaped as though this step up to 2m should be fine and she's strongly respected off only 1lb higher than last time.
runners.comment: 0-6 but she went close in a 1m6f handicap at Sandown last time; respected

runners.name: Pergamon
runners.spotlight: Big improver over hurdles and he made it 5-8 in that sphere when completing a hat-trick at Perth (2m, good) two weeks ago; looks interesting off dangerous mark on the Flat and he won over 1m7f in France as a 3yo.
runners.comment: Completed hurdle hat-trick 16 days ago and he's an interesting contender back on the Flat

races.race_name: Follow @racingtv On X Haydock Park Training Series Apprentice Handicap (Part Of The RE Series)

runners.name: No Knee Never
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been between 6f-8.5f on AW; has been below his best at York on last two starts and was reported to have run flat last time; drops back to a more suitable trip but he's still 4lb higher than for his last success; may be best watched until he returns to AW.
runners.comment: Has been below his best on last two runs on turf at York.

runners.name: Perfidia
runners.spotlight: Generally consistent apart from one moderate run on good to soft this year; he has won twice this summer, at Hamilton (8.5f, good) and over C&D (good to firm) with Jake Dickson on board; looks sure to give another good account.
runners.comment: He has won twice this summer, at Hamilton and over C&D with Jake Dickson on board.

runners.name: Tees George
runners.spotlight: In decent nick at present, winning his third race when scoring at Beverley (8.5, good to firm) in April off 2lb lower; made the frame on his two starts last month and holds place claims.
runners.comment: Made the frame on his two starts last month and holds place claims.

runners.name: Sceptic
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old but gained his fifth success, at Kempton (1m, AW) in May; beaten 4l at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) last month in an 18-runner contest but this smaller field should play to his strengths (all five wins have been in races with less than ten runners).
runners.comment: Scored at Kempton in May but down the field at Doncaster last month.

runners.name: Bay Dream Believer
runners.spotlight: Landed her seventh win when scoring at Pontefract (1m2f, good) last month but has run below par at Ripon and Musselburgh since; the step back in trip is also unlikely to play to her strengths.
runners.comment: Scored at Pontefract last month but has run below par at Ripon and Musselburgh since.

runners.name: Popeye Doyle
runners.spotlight: Both wins were on AW last summer when trained by Hugo Palmer; decent second at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) last month but below that level at Carlisle and Ripon since; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Decent second at Wetherby last month but below that level at Carlisle and Ripon since.

races.race_name: Racing TV Proudly Supports Teenage Cancer Trust Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Fully Stocked
runners.spotlight: Displayed a good attitude to lead again over 1f out after attempting to make all, only to be denied close home at Kempton (6f, AW) last month on debut; first start on turf and looks sure to run well.
runners.comment: Only denied close home at Kempton last month on debut.

runners.name: Paper View
runners.spotlight: Early days but looks no great shakes on the evidence of his three runs; has been gelded since his last start in May and may do better when running in nurseries.
runners.comment: Early days but looks no great shakes on the evidence of his three runs.

runners.name: Fast Performer
runners.spotlight: £58,000 yearling; fourth foal; by Showcasing; half-brother to winners Manara (1m-1m4f including 2yo/AW; RPR 89) and Dance Desire (KSA 7f-1m1f); dam 6f winner (including 2yo; 96), out of close relative of 1m2f Group 1 winner Wavering and half-sister to 1m2f 2yo Group 1 winner Mandaean; makes debut for top stable who are going well, but only had their first juvenile winner of the year this month.
runners.comment: Top stable going well but only had their first juvenile winner of the year this month.

runners.name: Parkers Light
runners.spotlight: Beaten 4l on debut when eighth of 11 at Bath (5.5f, firm; 33-1) 17 days ago; steps up in trip and needs to find improvement.
runners.comment: Beaten 4l on debut when eighth at Bath 17 days ago.

runners.name: Whiskey Bent
runners.spotlight: Well held when seventh of 11 over C&D (good) on debut in May; needs to show much more to get involved here.
runners.comment: Well held when seventh of 11 over C&D on debut in May.

races.race_name: Download The Free Racing TV App Now Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Sound And Vision
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in 5f Southwell (AW) novice in December; beat only one home on her handicap debut at Newcastle (5f, AW; 5-6) the following month; interesting to see what she can do on turf debut; market can guide.
runners.comment: Scored at Southwell in December; beaten favourite when well held after; turf debut

runners.name: Marajito
runners.spotlight: Recorded her second success, at Ripon (5f, good) in May off 3lb lower; below that level at Thirsk and Ayr since and needs to get back to her best to figure here.
runners.comment: Scored at Ripon in May but below that level at Thirsk and Ayr since.

runners.name: Starsong
runners.spotlight: Has won off higher marks in the past but not the force of old; drops back to the minimum trip for the first time since March 2024 and she looks vulnerable to younger rivals.
runners.comment: Has won off higher marks but not the force of old; drops back to the minimum trip.

runners.name: Double Naughty
runners.spotlight: Made a winning seasonal/stable debut when beating Control Room by a head at Bath (5.5f, good to firm) in May; below that form at Goodwood and Chepstow since and she needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Beat Control Room by a head at Bath in May but below that form twice since.

runners.name: Control Room
runners.spotlight: Landed a maiden at Catterick (5f, soft) last October and eyecatching handicap debut when beaten a head at Bath (5.5f, good) on seasonal return in May despite being unruly beforehand; left Robert Cowell subsequently; satisfactory stable debut when third of seven at Windsor (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; needs to settle better but should not be far away.
runners.comment: Made a satisfactory stable debut when third at Windsor and should not be far away

runners.name: Zoustar Dreams
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of an easing mark in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) when winning at Catterick (6f, good to firm) in May; demonstrated her versatility when following up at Lingfield (5f, soft) seven days later; unable to dominate when fourth of nine at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) subsequently but dangerous here if allowed an easy lead.
runners.comment: Made all for back-to-back wins at Catterick and Lingfield; unable to dominate last time

runners.name: Storm Call
runners.spotlight: Has won twice over 5f but has been below her best this year; has dropped to a career-low mark but doesn't look ready to take advantage.
runners.comment: Has won twice over 5f but has been below her best this year.

races.race_name: Steve Yarborough Memorial Handicap

runners.name: Del Corso
runners.spotlight: Consistent maiden but has been favourite three times; ran his best race last time when runner-up at Newbury (1m, good to firm) 16 days ago; steps up in trip and should not be far away.
runners.comment: Consistent maiden but has been favourite three times; ran his best race last time.

runners.name: Crimson Rambler
runners.spotlight: Won two AW handicaps for George Scott in March; ran well on the second of two outings for current stable when third of ten at Newmarket (1m, good) last month; this looks easier and he should go close, at the least.
runners.comment: Ran well on the second of two runs for current stable when third at Newmarket last month.

runners.name: Miss Pretty
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Kempton (7f, AW) last August but she hasn't built on that; first-time cheekpieces need to have a positive impact.
runners.comment: Made a winning debut at Kempton last August but she hasn't built on that success.

runners.name: Poor Relation
runners.spotlight: Performed with credit when runner-up on her second start, at Southwell (1m, AW) in January; comfortably held in two turf maidens on soft last month; needs to show more on this sounder surface on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Comfortably held in two turf maidens on soft last month.

races.race_name: Join Racing TV Now Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Thursday Girl
runners.spotlight: Has finished second on all of her three starts this year, going down by a neck at Sandown (1m, good) 15 days ago on her handicap debut; this looks a good opportunity for her to get off the mark.
runners.comment: Has finished second on all of her three starts this year; good opportunity

runners.name: Effetto
runners.spotlight: 12,000euros yearling; 30,000euros breeze-up 2yo; fifth foal; by Galiway; half-sister to winners Energia Tourismo (French 12.5f/14.5f), Kentucky Go Go (US 1m turf) and British Crown (Canadian 6.5f turf); dam 5f-1m4f winner (including 2yo/Group 3/Brazilian Grade 1; RPR 108); yard going great guns, especially with their 3yos, so she must be of interest on debut; stable also has Stellar entered.
runners.comment: Yard (runs two) going great guns, especially with 3yos, so she must be of interest.

runners.name: Stellar
runners.spotlight: 730,000euros yearling; first foal; by Sea The Stars; dam unraced half-sister to winners The Fugue (multiple 1m2f/1m4f Group 1s) and Excellency (Group-placed 1m, by Sea The Stars), out of useful 1m1f winning half-sister to Group 1 winners Summoner (QEII) and Compton Admiral (Eclipse); has an exemplary pedigree and should make an impact on this debut; stable also has Effetto entered.
runners.comment: Has an exemplary pedigree and should make an impact on this debut; yard runs two.

runners.name: Sedeirah
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward from her debut when runner-up to an easy winner at Pontefract (1m, good) last month; going the right way and holds claims.
runners.comment: Took a step forward from her debut when runner-up at Pontefract last month.

runners.name: Moonlit Surf
runners.spotlight: Made the frame for the first time when fourth on her handicap debut at Sandown (1m, good) last month; probably best chance of first success would be to go back down that route.
runners.comment: Made the frame for the first time when fourth on her handicap debut at Sandown last month.

races.race_name: Racedays For £9 At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap

runners.name: Ablon
runners.spotlight: Made virtually all to get off the mark in a Kempton novice (7f) in February; made an encouraging handicap debut when beaten less than 2l at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) 16 days ago; she should not be far away if that runs brings her on.
runners.comment: Made an encouraging handicap debut when beaten less than 2l at Newbury 16 days ago.
runners.owner: Mrs C Fruhbeck and Denford Stud

runners.name: Everyoneknowsadave
runners.spotlight: Has gained all of his three wins on the AW but is knocking on the door for his first turf win; placed on his last two runs, latest when runner-up at Leicester (1m2f, good) last month; claims.
runners.comment: Has gained all of his three wins on AW but is knocking on the door for his first turf win.

runners.name: Revelio
runners.spotlight: Showed much improved form when stepping up in trip on his handicap debut to be runner-up at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago; should step on from that and holds strong claims.
runners.comment: Showed improved form when stepping up in trip when runner-up at Lingfield three weeks ago.

runners.name: Caelan
runners.spotlight: Won twice on AW for Marco Botti; scored over hurdles last September; all but refused to race when trailing in last of four at Ffos Las (1m4f, good) on Monday; one to have serious reservations about at present.
runners.comment: All but refused to race when trailing in last of four at Ffos Las on Monday.

runners.name: Didaar
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 18th attempt over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago off 3lb lower on his second run for this yard, with Jake Dickson aboard him; needs to come on again in this higher grade.
runners.comment: Off the mark at the 18th attempt over C&D two weeks ago off 3lb lower.

runners.name: Woodstock City
runners.spotlight: Won twice in Britain for current yard since winning twice in France; however, beaten 21l at Leicester (1m2f, good) last month following five-month layoff and lacks the scope of his rivals.
runners.comment: Beaten 21l at Leicester last month following five-month layoff.

races.race_name: United Nations Stakes (Grade 2) (Turf)
NYRA Bets Haskell Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)

runners.name: Ocelli
runners.spotlight: Late-running horse capable of smart efforts but not necessarily wins of same class; in frame in Grade 1 company in May in Kentucky Derby and Preakness Stakes; another belated effort when 1l second to Chip Honcho in Grade 3 Ohio Derby at Thistledown (1m1f) last month; strong chance of a minor place.
runners.comment: Late runner, in frame in two Classics and again in Grade 3 latest; place claims
runners.owner: Ashley Durr, Anthony Tate & Front Page Equestrian LLC

runners.name: Further Ado
runners.spotlight: Very impressive in Grade 1 Blue Grass Stakes at Keeneland (1m1f; won by 11l) in May but disappointing favourite for Grade 1 Kentucky Derby (11th of 18, never looking likely to take hand in finish); returned to best to win Grade 3 Matt Winn Stakes at Churchill Downs in June by 2l; seems to need daylight tracking leaders and should get that kind of scenario here.
runners.comment: Clear chance on Grade 1 and Grade 3 wins (well-beaten Kentucky Derby favourite in between)

runners.name: Iron Honor
runners.spotlight: Successful on first two starts, both at Aqueduct, in maiden last December and Grade 3 Gotham Stakes (1m; by 1l) in April; ran best race yet when second to Napoleon Solo in Grade 1 Preakness Stakes at Laurel (9.5f) in May, closing to just over 1l behind winner; open to more improvement and strong claims.
runners.comment: Grade 3 winner ran best race when second to Napoleon Solo in Preakness Stakes; big chance
runners.owner: St Elias Stable, William H Lawrence & Glassman Racing

runners.name: Napoleon Solo
runners.spotlight: Strong-running horse with a ton of early pace; career-best effort to beat Iron Honor by just over 1l in Preakness Stakes at Laurel (9.5f; second Grade 1 win) in May; travelled really strongly to take command there and value for more than winning margin (had suffered foot problems and may have been short of work); could still be open to more improvement and likely the one to beat.
runners.comment: Dual Grade 1 winner, including Preakness Stakes at Laurel (9.5f) in May; bold bid on cards

runners.name: The Puma
runners.spotlight: Very smart form in four starts, winning Grade 3 Tampa Bay Derby (8.5f) in March but better effort still when beaten nose by Commandment in Grade 1 Florida Derby (1m1f) later same month; missed Kentucky Derby (and training time since) with skin infection but could still take a hand after the layoff.
runners.comment: Grade 3 winner, touched off in Grade 1 Florida Derby; off injured since; still respected
runners.owner: OGMA Investments LLC, JR Ranch & High Step Racing LLC

runners.name: Star Sweeper
runners.spotlight: Useful form in Listed and black type events but no form close to the level needed to defeat these.
runners.comment: Useful performer but looks well out of depth
runners.owner: Bran Jam Stable & David W Clark

runners.name: Baby Vino
runners.spotlight: Impressive winner of Listed Pegasus Stakes here (8.5f), the acknowledged local prep for this; that form still leaves him with a lot to find.
runners.comment: Impressive Listed winner here (8.5f) last time but has lots to find.
runners.owner: Cosmo Stables And Delta Squad Racing, Llc

races.race_name: Dunkin' Diana Stakes (Grade 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)

runners.name: Segesta
runners.spotlight: Signed off last season with impressive Grade 1 Matriarch Stakes win at Del Mar (1m) but has not quite reached the same level this season, including when dead-heating for Grade 1 Jenny Wiley Stakes at Keeneland (8.5f) in May; again found less than anticipated when about 2l third in Grade 1 Just A Game here last time (1m; may be worth riding more patiently); has to be respected but needs to return to 2025 best.
runners.comment: Dual Grade 1 winner but found little when third in Grade 1 here (1m) latest; respected

runners.name: Kathynmarissa
runners.spotlight: Progressive form over three seasons, looking a very smart prospect; won Grade 3 Modesty Stakes at Churchill Downs in May by just over 1l, again showing good turn of foot; creditable effort (raced wide) when about 2l third to Portfolio Duration in Grade 1 New York Stakes over slightly further here; freshened and must go well.
runners.comment: Progressive mare; won Grade 3 in May; good third in Grade 1 six weeks ago; must go well

runners.name: Cathedral
runners.spotlight: Sole win in a maiden but very useful form, including when fourth in Grade 1 Breeders' Cup Filly & Mare Turf at Del Mar (1m3f) last November and when just under 2l third to Jancis in Group 2 Dahlia at Newmarket (1m1f, good to firm) in May; run best ignored (trapped wide, did too much early) behind Blue Bolt in Group 2 at Royal Ascot latest; can reward enterprising bid with at least a place.
runners.comment: Has very useful form, including in Group/Grade 1 races; run best ignored latest; chance

runners.name: Dynamic Pricing
runners.spotlight: Night Of Thunder mare who has won five of 14 starts, notably Grade 1 Just A Game Stakes here (1m, yielding) last June; creditable third in this race last year; favourite, good second to City Girl in Grade 3 Beaugay Stakes at Aqueduct last time; goes well here (form 3131) and has good claims, especially if forecast rain comes early.
runners.comment: Grade 1 winner, third in this last year; solid second last time and has good claims

runners.name: Portfolio Duration
runners.spotlight: Has made into smart performer in just five starts; unlucky in Grade 2 on penultimate occasion, then made all in Grade 1 New York Stakes over slightly further here, receiving brilliant ride from Flavien Prat; unlikely to catch rivals so cold this time, but improving profile demands respect.
runners.comment: Made all under fine ride in Grade 1 New York Stakes here (9.5f) last time; demands respect

runners.name: Ozara
runners.spotlight: Best effort to win Grade 2 Ballston Spa Stakes here (8.5f) last August but looked a bit out of her depth in two Grade 1s afterwards; won minor event at Monmouth on comeback but only sixth when favourite for Grade 3 at Woodbine last time; needs to improve a fair bit to challenge these rivals.
runners.comment: Grade 2 winner; has looked out of depth at this level; beaten favourite in Grade 3 latest

runners.name: Five G
runners.spotlight: Very useful form on dirt; lightly raced on turf, including when 1l third in a conditions race here (8.5f) last time, running on willingly in a slowly run event; far from exposed but has plenty to find.
runners.comment: Very useful on dirt; lightly raced turf, 3rd in minor race here (8.5f) latest; stiff task

runners.name: Cy Fair

runners.owner: The Estate Of R Larry Johnson
